verses.text: Habaye umugabo umwe yaba i Ramatayimu-Zofimu mu karere k’imisozi y’Abefurayimu, yitwa Elukana mwene Yerohamu, Yerohamu mwene Elihu, Elihu mwene Tohu, Tohu mwene Zufi, wo mu muryango wa Efurayimu.
Yari afise abagore babiri, umwe yitwa Hana uwundi yitwa Penina. Penina yari afise abana, ariko Hana ntiyagira n’umwe.

Uko umwaka utashe uwo mugabo yama ava mu gisagara c’iwabo akaduga gusenga no gushikanira Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ikimazi i Shilo, aho abahungu ba Eli babiri, Hofuni na Finehasi, bakorera nk’abaherezi b’ Uhoraho .
Igihe cose hageze ko Elukana atanga ikimazi, yama aha imigabane y’inyama umugore wiwe Penina n’abahungu biwe n’abakobwa biwe bose.
Ariko Hana we yamuha umugabane ungana incuro zibiri uwa Penina kuko yamukunda, naho Uhoraho yari yaramwimye uruvyaro.
Mukeba wiwe yama amucurira ngo amubabaze, kubera Uhoraho yari yaramwimye uruvyaro.
Ivyo vyabandanije gutyo uko imyaka yakurikirana. Igihe cose Hana yaja mu nzu y’ Uhoraho , mukeba wiwe yama amucurira gushika aho arira ntagire n’ico afungura.
Elukana umugabo wiwe akamubwira ati: “Hana, ni kuki urira? Ni kuki udafungura? Ni kuki ubabaye? Mbega sindakurutira abahungu icumi wovyaye?”
Igihe kimwe bahejeje kurya no kunywa i Shilo, Hana arahaguruka. Ico gihe Eli umuherezi yari yicaye ku ntebe ku muryango w’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .
Hana asenga Uhoraho n’umubabaro mwinshi wo mu mutima ararira cane.

Asezerana isezerano, avuga ati: “Yewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, niwaraba amagorwa yanje umusavyikazi wawe ukanyibuka, ntiwibagire umusavyikazi wawe ukampa umwana w’umuhungu, nanje nzomushikanira Uhoraho mu misi y’ukubaho kwiwe kwose, kandi nta rwembe ruzokwigera rumugera ku mutwe.”
Uko yashishikara gusenga Uhoraho , ni ko Eli yamuraba ku munwa.
Hana yasengera ku mutima, kandi agakubita iminwa naho ijwi ryiwe ritumvikana. Eli we yibaza ko yaborewe,
aca aramubwira ati: “Uzogeza ryari kwama uborewe? Heba uwo muvinyu wawe.”

Hana aramwishura ati: “Oyaye nyakwubahwa, si ko biri, ndi umugore afise ingorane nyinshi. Sinanyoye umuvinyu canke ikindi kiboreza na kimwe, nariko ndasuka umubabaro wo mu mutima wanje imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Ntiwibaze ko umusavyikazi wawe ndi umugore w’umunyangesombi, nariko ndasenga kubera umubabaro n’agahinda biri muri jewe.”
Eli aramwishura ati: “Niwigire amahoro, Imana y’Abisirayeli ikwishure iguhe ico wayisavye.”
Na we aravuga ati: “Icompa umusavyikazi wawe nkagirirwa ubuntu imbere yawe.” Nuko aca ava aho hantu, arafungura, maze mu maso hiwe ntihasubira kwiraburanirwa.
Mu gitondo ca kare baravyuka basenga Uhoraho hanyuma basubira iwabo i Rama. Elukana aryamana n’umugore wiwe Hana, maze Uhoraho aramwibuka.
Nuko Hana asama inda avyara umuhungu amwita Samweli, avuga ati: “Kuko namusavye Uhoraho .”
Hageze ko Elukana adugana n’umuryango wiwe wose gushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi c’umwaka no gushitsa isezerano ryiwe,
Hana ntiyashoboye kujana na bo. Nuko abwira umugabo wiwe ati: “Uwu muhungu niyacuka, nzomujana ndamushikanire Uhoraho , na we azoba imbere y’Uhoraho ibihe vyose.”

Elukana umugabo wiwe aramubwira ati: “Uze ukore ikizokubera ciza. Guma ngaha gushika umucukije; kimwe gusa Uhoraho ashitse ijambo ryiwe.” Nuko uwo mugore aguma i muhira arera umuhungu wiwe gushika aho yamucukirije.
Amaze kumucutsa, ajana wa muhungu, naho yari akiri muto, n’ishuri imaze imyaka itatu, n’ifu ingana n’ingero efa n’umukuza w’umuvinyu, amujana mu nzu y’ Uhoraho i Shilo.
Bamaze gutanga ya shuri kw’ikimazi, bazanira Eli wa muhungu,
nyina wiwe aramubwira ati: “Nyakwubahwa, urakaramba! Ndi wa mugore nahagarara i ruhande yawe nsenga Uhoraho .
Nariko ndasaba uwu mwana, none Uhoraho yampaye ico namusavye.
None ubu ndamushikaniye Uhoraho . Ubuzima bwiwe bwose azoba ari uw’ Uhoraho .” Maze bapfukamira Uhoraho baramusenga.
Maze Hana asenga Uhoraho avuga ati: “Umutima wanje unezererewe Uhoraho ; Uhoraho we wangize uwukomeye. Ubu ndafise ico nishura abansi banje, kuko nezerejwe n’ugutabara kwawe.
Nta wera nk’ Uhoraho ; nta wundi yoboneka i ruhande yawe; nta Gitandara gihwanye n’Imana yacu.
Nimureke kuvugana ubwibone, iminwa yanyu ntivuge ivyo kwishira hejuru, kuko Uhoraho ari Imana izi vyose, kandi ni yo ipima ibikorwa vyose ku munzane.
Imiheto y’abagwanyi iravunaguritse, ariko abahoze ari abanyantegenke bambitswe inkomezi.
Abari bafise ivyuzuye, babaye abacangero, bakorera ivyo barya kandi abahora bashonje, bashize inzara. Uwahora yitwa ingumba, avyaye abana indwi, ariko uwari afise abahungu benshi arakabiranye.
Uhoraho ni we atuma umuntu apfa kandi ni we atuma abaho; ni we amanura bamwe i kuzimu, abandi akabakurayo.
Uhoraho ni we atuma bamwe bakena, kandi ni we atuma abandi batunga; ni we acisha bugufi bamwe, agashira hejuru abandi.
Akura umugorwa mu mukungugu, ashira hejuru umukene, amukuye mu mwavu; akamwicarikana n’abakomeye, akamuha intebe y’icubahiro. Kuko imfatiro z’isi ari iz’ Uhoraho ; Kandi kuri zo ni ho yashinze isi.
Ni we azozigama ibirenge vy’abamukorera mu bwizigirwa, ariko abanyakibi bazokamanganira mu mwijima. Inkomezi z’umuntu si zo zituma anesha;

abagwanya Uhoraho bazocika ubunywenywe. Iyisumbavyose izobaturagarirako iri mw’ijuru; Uhoraho azocira urubanza impera z’isi. Azoha inkomezi umwami yimitse kandi yongere inkomezi uwo yimikishije amavuta.”
Hanyuma Elukana ataha iwe i Rama, ariko wa muhungu akorera Uhoraho ari musi y’uburongozi bwa Eli umuherezi.
Abahungu ba Eli bari abantu babi; ntibubaha Uhoraho .

Hariho ingeso abaherezi bari basigaye bafise y’uko igihe cose umuntu yaza gushikana ikimazi, umukozi w’umuherezi yaca azana icaruzo c’amenyo atatu mu minwe, akaza igihe inyama z’ico kimazi zikiriko ziratogotera ku ziko,
agaca yinjiza ca caruzo mu nkono canke mu kintu cose batetsemwo izo nyama, umuherezi agaca atwara izo ico caruzo caruye. Ivyo ni vyo bagirira Abisirayeli bose baza i Shilo.

Vyaranashika ko umukozi w’umuherezi aza ibinure vy’ikimazi bitaraturirwa n’umuriro ku gicaniro, akabwira uwariko arashikana ikimazi ati: “Zana inyama zo kwokereza umuherezi; ntashaka izimaze gutekwa, ashaka izikiri mbisi.”
Iyo uwo muntu yishuye ati: “Reka mbanze nturire ibinure vyazo, hanyuma uheze utware izo ugomba zose,” uwo mukozi yaca yishura ati: “Oya zizane ubu nyene; utazizanye naho, ndaziha ku nguvu.”
Ico caha c’abo bahungu cari kinini cane mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kuko bakengera ibimazi vyiwe.
Ariko Samweli we naho yari akiri agahungu gatoya yakomeje gukorera Uhoraho . Yambara efodi yera nk’iyo abaherezi bambara.
Uko umwaka utashe, nyina yama amushonera agakanzu gatoya akakamushira aduganye n’umugabo wiwe gutanga ikimazi c’umwaka.

Imbere y’uko bataha, Eli yama aca ahezagira Elukana n’umugore wiwe, akavuga ati: “ Uhoraho aguhe abana kuri uwu mugore kugira ngo baje mu gishingo c’uwu yasengeye agaca amuha Uhoraho .” Bagaca bataha.
Kandi Uhoraho agirira ubuntu Hana; avyara abahungu batatu n’abakobwa babiri. Wa mwana Samweli na we abandanya akurira imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Ico gihe Eli yari ashaje cane, ariko yarumva ivyo abahungu biwe bakorera Abisirayeli, ko baryamana n’abagore bakorera ibikorwa mu rwinjiriro rw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Nuko akama ababwira ngo: “Ni kuki mukora ibintu nk’ivyo? Numva abantu bose babavuga ko mwigenza nabi.
Nimusigeho, bana banje! Inkuru numva ivugwa mu bantu b’ Uhoraho si nziza.

Iyo umuntu acumuye ku wundi, Imana ishobora kubuzuriza; ariko umuntu acumuye k’ Uhoraho , ni nde yomuvugira?” Ariko abahungu biwe ntibumvira impanuro za se, kuko Uhoraho yari yagabiye ko bategerezwa gupfa.
Samweli we abandanya gukura mu mubiri no kugira igikundiro k’ Uhoraho no ku bantu.
Nuko haza umuntu w’Imana ashikira Eli aramubwira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Siniyeretse abo mu nzu ya so igihe bari bakiri muri Egiputa baganzwa na Farawo?’ ”

Natoranije so mu yindi miryango yose y’Abisirayeli ngo ambere umuherezi, ngo aje ku gicaniro canje, acane ibimota neza, kandi yambare efodi imbere y’inyonga zanje. Kandi nahaye abo mu nzu ya so ibimazi vyose vyoswa n’Abisirayeli.
None ni kuki mukengera ikimazi canje n’ishikanwa ryanje? Ni kuki wubaha abahungu bawe ukabandutisha mu kwirira inyama z’indobanurwa z’ibimazi vyose ihanga ryanje ry’Abisirayeli batanze?

“Nguku rero uko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Nari narasezeranye ko inzu ya so ari yo izokorera imbere yanje ibihe vyose.’ Ubu rero Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Ntibikabe!’ Abanyubaha ni bo nzokwubaha, ariko abankengera nanje nzobakengera.”
Ehe igihe kiraje aho nzokwaka inkomezi wewe n’inzu ya so nkabaka ubuherezi, kugira ngo ntihabe hakibaho umuntu aramba mu ruvyaro rwawe,
kandi uzoba mu mubabaro uri mu nzu yanje. Naho Abisirayeli bazogirirwa neza, mu ruvyaro rwawe ntihazokwigera hongera kuboneka umuntu aramba agashika mu zabukuru.
Uwo nzosigaza adakuwe ku gicaniro canje azoba ari uwo kuguteza umubabaro no kukwihebuza, kandi abo mu ruvyaro rwawe bose bazopfa bakiri bato. Ariko abandi bose bazopfa bakiri mu myaka y’ubuto.
“ ‘Ibizoba kuri Hofuni na Finehasi, abahungu bawe babiri, bizoba ikimenyetso c’ivyo, bazopfira umusi umwe.

Nzokwitorera uwuzombera umuherezi w’umwizigirwa, azokora ibiri ku mutima wanje no mu vyiyumviro vyanje. Kandi nzokomeza inzu y’ubuherezi bwiwe, baze bame bakorera imbere y’abami nasize amavuta ibihe vyose.

Ico gihe umuntu wese wo mu muryango wawe azosigara azoza amwunamire kugira ngo amuhe igiceri kimwe c’ifeza n’akavunguka k’umukate kandi amwinginge ati: “Ntabara umpe ico nkora mu bikorwa vy’ubuherezi kugira ngo ndonke ico kurya.” ’ ”
Uwo muhungu Samweli akorera Uhoraho musi y’uburongozi bwa Eli. Kandi, muri iyo misi, kwumva ijambo ry’ Uhoraho vyari imbonekarimwe; no kwerekwa kwari guke cane.
Ico gihe, Eli ntiyari akibona neza, amaso yiwe yari atanguye guhuma. Ijoro rimwe, Eli aja kuryama aho yari asanzwe aryama.
Itara ry’ Uhoraho ntiryari bwazime, kandi na Samweli yari aryamye mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , impande y’Isandugu y’Imana.
Maze Uhoraho ahamagara Samweli. Samweli aritaba ati: “Sabwe!”
Aca yiruka iyo Eli ari aravuga ati: “Ndi hano; wampamagaye?” Ariko Eli aravuga ati: “Sinaguhamagaye, subira kuryama.” Nuko aragenda araryama.
Uhoraho asubira guhamagara ati: “Samweli!” Maze Samweli aravyuka aja iyo Eli ari aravuga ati: “Ndi hano; wampamagaye?” Eli aramwishura ati: “Mwana wanje, sinaguhamagaye; subira kuryama.”
Samweli ntiyari bwamenye Uhoraho kuko ntiyari bwumve ijambo rivuye k’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho ahamagara Samweli ubugira gatatu, maze Samweli aravyuka aja iyo Eli ari aravuga ati: “Ndi hano; wampamagaye?” Maze Eli aca amenya ko ari Uhoraho ariko arahamagara uwo muhungu.
Nuko Eli aca abwira Samweli ati: “Genda uryame, niyasubira kuguhamagara, uce uvuge uti: ‘Vuga, Uhoraho , kuko umusavyi wawe ndaguteze amatwi.’ ” Nuko Samweli aragenda araryama mu kibanza ciwe.
Maze Uhoraho araza asubira guhamagara nk’uko yari yamye abigira ubwa mbere ati: “Samweli! Samweli!” Maze Samweli aravuga ati: “Vuga, kuko umusavyi wawe ndaguteze amatwi.”
Nuko Uhoraho abwira Samweli ati: “Ehe, ngira nkore ikintu mu Bisirayeli kizotuma uwuzocumva wese agira iminzerere mu matwi.
Ngiye gushitsa kuri Eli ivyo namuburiye vyose ko bizomubako n’umuryango wiwe, uhereye ku ca mbere gushika ku ca nyuma.
Naramuburiye ko ngiye gucira urubanza rw’ibihe vyose umuryango wiwe kubera icaha co gucokora Uhoraho asanzwe azi neza ko abahungu biwe bakora, ariko ntababuze.
Kubera ivyo nararahiye abo mu nzu ya Eli nti: ‘Icaha c’inzu ya Eli ntikizokwigera gitangirwa impongano yaba iy’ikimazi canke iy’ishikanwa.’ ”
Samweli asubira kuryama gushika mu gitondo aca yugurura imyango y’inzu y’ Uhoraho , ariko aratinya kubwira Eli ivyo yabwiwe.
Ariko Eli aramuhamagara amubwira ati: “Samweli mwana wanje.” Samweli arishura ati: “Sabwe!”
Eli aramubaza ati: “Mbega bwabundi, Uhoraho yakubwiye iki? Ntubimpishe. Imana ibiguhanire, kandi birushirije, niwaramuka umpishije na kimwe mu vyo yakubariye.”
Nuko Samweli amubwira vyose, ata na kimwe amuhishije. Nuko Eli aravuga ati: “Ni Uhoraho ; nakore ibibereye mu nyonga ziwe.”
Uhoraho abana na Samweli mu gukura kwiwe, kandi ijambo ryose Samweli yavuga Imana yararyubahiriza ikarishitsa.
Kandi Abisirayeli bose uhereye i Dani ugushika i Berisheba bamenya ko Samweli ari uwuvugishwa n’ Uhoraho w’ukuri.
Uhoraho abandanya kwiyerekanira aho i Shilo, akiyereka Samweli biciye mw’ijambo ryiwe.
Kandi amajambo ya Samweli yagenda ashikirizwa Abisirayeli bose.
Abafilisitiya bakoranya ingabo zabo zose kugira ngo baje gutera Abisirayeli. Intambara irakomera cane, maze Abisirayeli baneshwa n’Abafilisitiya, babicamwo abantu ibihumbi bine ku rugamba.

Abasoda bagarutse aho bari bacumbitse, abakuru b’Abisirayeli barabaza bati: “Ni kuki Uhoraho yatumye tuneshwa uwu musi imbere y’Abafilisitiya? Nimuze tuzane Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho iri i Shilo, kugira ngo ajane natwe adukize ukuboko kw’abansi bacu.”

Nuko abantu batuma intumwa i Shilo, baragenda bazana ya Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avyagiye ku ntebe y’ubwami hagati y’Abakerubi. Abahungu ba Eli babiri, Hofuni na Finehasi, bari kumwe n’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’Imana.
Ya Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho ishitse aho bacumbitse, Abisirayeli bose barahaguruka biha akamo gakomeye kugeza aho isi inyiganyiga.
Abafilisitiya bumvise ako kamo, barabazanya bati: “Mbega ako kamo ko mu Baheburayo kavuye ku ki?” Bamaze kumenya ko ari kubera Isandugu y’ Uhoraho ishitse aho bacumbitse,
Abafilisitiya bagira ubwoba. Baravuga bati: “Imana yaje hagati muri bo. Turashize! Nta kintu nk’ico cari bwigere kibaho!
Turashize! Ni nde yodukiza ukuboko kw’izo mana zikomeye z’Abisirayeli? Izo ni zo zateje ivyago bikomeye cane Abanyegiputa igihe Abisirayeli bari mu bugaragwa.
Yemwe Bafilisitiya nimushikame! Mube abagabo, atari aho na ho muca muba abagurano b’Abaheburayo, nk’uko na bo bahora ari abagurano bacu. Nimube abagabo, mugwane!”
Nuko Abafilisitiya baragwana, hanyuma Abisirayeli baraneshwa, umuntu wese ahungira mw’ihema ryiwe. Abishwe bari benshi cane; uwo musi mu Bisirayeli hapfa abasoda ibihumbi mirongo itatu.
Isandugu y’Imana irafatwa, na Hofuni na Finehasi bene Eli barapfa.
Kuri uwo musi nyene, umuntu umwe wo mu muryango wa Benyamini ariruka ava ku rugamba aja i Shilo, yitabaguriyeko impuzu ziwe, yisutse n’umukungugu mu mutwe.

Ashitse asanga Eli yicaye ku ntebe yiwe i ruhande y’inzira, agerageza kwumva amakuru y’intambara, kuko yari ahagaritswe umutima n’Isandugu y’Imana. Uwo muntu yinjiye mu gisagara ababwira ivyabaye, abo muri ico gisagara bose baca bakoma induru.
Eli yumvise iyo nduru aca abaza ati: “Mbega iyo nduru ni iy’iki?” Wa muntu yihutira kuja aho Eli yari ari.
Eli yari amaze imyaka mirongo icenda n’umunani, amaso yiwe yarahumye atakibona.
Nuko abwira Eli ati: “Mvuye ubu nyene ku rugamba; mpunze mvayo uwu musi nyene.” Eli aramubaza ati: “None vyagenze gute ga mwana wanje?”

Wa muntu yazanye inkuru arishura ati: “Abisirayeli bahunze imbere y’Abafilisitiya, kandi hapfuye abasoda benshi cane. Mbere n’abahungu bawe bompi, Hofuni na Finehasi bapfuye, n’Isandugu y’Imana bayitwaye.”

Amaze kuvuga ivy’Isandugu y’Imana, Eli yikubita hasi atanguza umugongo avuye kuri ya ntebe yiwe aho yari ari i ruhande y’irembo. Izosi ryiwe riravunika aca arapfa, kuko yari ashaje kandi avyibushe cane. Yari amaze imyaka mirongo ine ari umucamanza w’Abisirayeli.

Umukazana wiwe, muka Finehasi, yari afise inda igeze kuvuka, yumvise iyo nkuru ko Isandugu y’Imana yafashwe kandi ko sebukwe n’umugabo wiwe bose bapfuye, afatwa n’ibise aca aravyara, ariko agira umubabaro urenze urugero.
Ari ku mpfiro, abakirizi baravuga bati: “Ntiwihebure; uvyaye umuhungu.” Ariko ntiyagira ico yishura canke ngo anavyiteho.
Yita uwo muhungu Ikabodi, risigura ngo: “Icubahiro kivuye kuri Isirayeli,” kuko bafashe Isandugu y’Imana kandi sebukwe n’umugabo wiwe bakaba bapfuye.
Aravuga ati: “Icubahiro cavuye kuri Isirayeli ko Isandugu y’Imana yafashwe.”

headings.text: Abafilisitiya bafata Isandugu y’Isezerano Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli baja kugwana n’Abafilisitiya. Abisirayeli bakoranira ahitwa Ebenezeri, Abafilisitiya na bo bakoranira ahitwa Afeki.

verses.text: Abafilisitiya bamaze gufata Isandugu y’Imana, bayikura i Ebenezeri bayijana i Ashidodi.
Batwara iyo Sandugu mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana Dagoni baca bayishira hambavu ya Dagoni.

Ariko, umusi ukurikira mu gitondo, abantu b’i Ashidodi, baravye babona ico kigirwamana Dagoni caguye cubamye hasi imbere ya ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho ! Baca bafata ico kigirwamana Dagoni bagisubiza mu kibanza caco.
Bukeye mu gitondo bavyutse, babona ico kigirwamana Dagoni cubamye imbere y’Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , umutwe waco n’ibikonjo vyaco vyacitse birambaraye mu rwinjiriro; umutumba waco usigaye uri wonyene.
Ni co gituma gushika n’ubu ata muherezi wa Dagoni canke uwundi muntu yinjira mu ngoro ya Dagoni iri i Ashidodi ashobora gukandagira mu rwinjiriro.
Ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwari guhanamiye abantu b’i Ashidodi n’imihana ihakikije; kuko kwabateza ivyago n’ibihute.
Abantu b’i Ashidodi babonye ibibaye, baravuga bati: “Isandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli ntishobora kuguma hano muri twebwe, kuko ukuboko kwayo kugomba kuturandura twebwe n’imana yacu Dagoni.”

Nuko batumako abatware bose b’Abafilisitiya barababaza bati: “Iyi Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli tuyigire dute?” Na bo barabishura bati: “Iyo Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli nimuyimurire i Gati.” Nuko barayimura.
Ariko bamaze kuyimura, ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kubangamira abantu b’ico gisagara, bituma bacika ivutu rwose. Abantu b’ico gisagara, uhereye ku bakiri bato ukageza ku bashaje, bose baterwa n’ibihute.

Nuko baca barungika iyo Sandugu y’Imana i Ekuroni. Ya sandugu igiseruka i Ekuroni, abantu baho bose bakoma induru bati: “Bazanye ya Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli muri twebwe kugira ngo itwicane n’abacu.”

Nuko baca batumako abatware bose b’Abafilisitiya baravuga bati: “Nimwirukane iyo Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli; muyisubize aho yahora, bitari uko na ho izotumara twebwe n’abantu bacu.” Abantu bo muri ico gisagara bari bacitse ivutu rwose, kubera ubwoba, batinya gupfa; kuko ukuboko kw’Imana kwari kubangamiye ico gisagara.
Abatapfuye bafashwe n’ibihute birabasesereza cane, gushika aho amaborogo y’abo muri ico gisagara aduga agashika mw’ijuru.

headings.text: Isandugu y’Imana ija i Ashidodi n’i Ekuroni

verses.text: Iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho imaze mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya amezi indwi,
Abafilisitiya bahamagara abaherezi n’abapfumu barababaza bati: “Iyi Sandugu y’ Uhoraho tuyigire dute? Tubwire uko twoyirungika igasubira iyo yaje iva.”

Barabishura bati: “Nimwasubiza iyo Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli, ntimuyirungike igaragara, ariko muyirungikane n’ikimazi co kwisaba, kugira ngo mukire ivyo vyago. Nimwakira, muzoca mumenya ko ivyo vyago mwabiterwa n’ukuboko kwayo.”

Abafilisitiya barababaza bati: “Ni ikihe kimazi co kwisaba twoyishikanira?” Barabishura bati: “Ni ibihute bitanu bicuzwe mu nzahabu n’imbeba zitanu zicuzwe mu nzahabu, nk’uko igitigiri c’abatware b’Abafilisitiya kingana, kuko ivyo vyago vyabateye mwebwe n’abatware banyu bose.

Mucure ibishushanyo vy’ivyo bihute n’izo mbeba biriko biratikiza igihugu, hanyuma mubirungikire iyo Mana y’Abisirayeli muyihe icubahiro. Kumbure yobagirira ikigongwe ikabakurako ukuboko kwayo kubahanamiye mwebwe n’imana zanyu n’igihugu canyu.
Ni kuki mukomantaza imitima yanyu nka kumwe Abanyegiputa na Farawo bagira? Mbega iyo Mana imaze kubahana bikomeye, ntibahavuye barekura Abisirayeli bakigira?
Nuko rero, nimurondere umukogote mushasha, n’inka zibiri zonsa kandi zitigeze zambikwa ingogo, muheze muziremeke uwo mukogote, ariko inyana zazo muzisubize mu ruhongore.

Mwakire ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho muyishire kuri wa mukogote, mushire i ruhande yayo akandi gasandugu karimwo vya bihute na za mbeba bicuzwe mu nzahabu mwateguye kumushikanira nk’ikimazi co kwisaba, hanyuma muce mureka izo nka zigende,

ariko muzikurikize amaso. Nizaduga zija mu gihugu ca Isirayeli, zikagenda zerekeye i Beti-Shemeshi, azoba ari Uhoraho yaduteje ibi vyago. Ariko nibitaba uko, tuzoca tumenya ko atari ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwadukubise, ko ivyadushikiye ari ivyizanye gutyo gusa.”
Nuko bakora uko nyene. Bafata za nka baziboherako wa mukogote baca basubiza inyana zazo mu ruhongore.
Bashira ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho ku mukogote hamwe na ka gasandugu karimwo za mbeba zicuzwe mu nzahabu na vya bimenyetso vy’ibihute.

Nuko za nka zigenda zerekeye i Beti-Shemeshi, zitumbereye inzira kandi zigenda zabira inzira yose; ntizahindukira i buryo canke i bubamfu. Abatware b’Abafilisitiya barazikurikira gushika zigeze ku rubibe rw’i Beti-Shemeshi.
Abantu b’i Beti-Shemeshi bariko barimbura ingano mu kiyaya, bunamutse babona ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho , banezerezwa cane no kuyibona.

Uwo mukogote uraza ushika mu murima wa Yosuwa w’i Beti-Shemeshi, uhagararaho i ruhande y’igitandara kinini. Abantu baca basatagura ibiti bigize wa mukogote baca batanga za nka kw’ikimazi co guturirwa bagishikanira Uhoraho .

Abalewi bururutsa ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho , na ka gasandugu karimwo vya bintu bicuzwe mu nzahabu, babirambika kuri ca gitandara kinini. Kuri uwo musi abantu b’i Beti-Shemeshi bashikanira Uhoraho amashikanwa aturiwe n’ibimazi.
Ba bakuru batanu b’Abafilisitiya babonye ivyo vyose baca basubira i Ekuroni kuri uwo musi nyene.
Vya bihute bicuzwe mu nzahabu Abafilisitiya barungitse nk’ikimazi co kwisaba bashikaniye Uhoraho vyatanzwe n’abakuru b’ibisagara vya Ashidodi, Gaza, Ashikeloni, Gati na Ekuroni.

Igitigiri ca za mbeba zicuzwe mu nzahabu cangana n’igitigiri c’ibisagara vy’i Bufilisitiya vyatwarwa n’abatware batanu, ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro n’imihana ihakikije. Ico gitandara kinini, bateretseko iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho , ni icabona c’ivyabaye gushika n’uno musi aho kiri mu murima wa Yosuwa w’i Beti-Shemeshi.
Ariko Uhoraho ahana abantu bamwe b’i Beti-Shemeshi, yica mirongo indwi muri bo kuko baravye mw’Isandugu y’ Uhoraho . Abantu barabagandarira bababajwe n’uko Uhoraho yari yabahanye bikomeye.
Abantu b’i Beti-Shemeshi barabazanya bati: “Ni nde yoshobora guhagarara imbere y’ Uhoraho , iyo Mana itunganye? Mbega iyi sandugu twoyijana kwa nde ngo tuyikure hano?”
Baca barungika intumwa ku bantu b’i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu, bavuga bati: “Abafilisitiya bagarukanye ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho . Nimumanuke muyidugane iwanyu.”
Nuko abantu b’i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu badugana iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho , bayijana mu rugo kwa Abinadabu rwari ku gasozi, baca barobanura Eliyezeri umuhungu wiwe kugira ngo yiteho iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho .

Iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho imara igihe kirekire kingana n’imyaka mirongo ibiri yose, ikiri i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu. Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli bose batakambira Uhoraho bababaye kuko bumva umenga Uhoraho yarabahevye.

Maze Samweli abwira Abisirayeli bose ati: “Nimwaba mugarutse k’ Uhoraho n’imitima yanyu yose, nimwitandukanye n’ibigirwamana vy’amahanga hamwe n’ibishushanyo vya Ashitaroti, mwiyegurire Uhoraho kandi mumukorere wenyene, na we azobakiza abakure mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.”
Nuko Abisirayeli bitandukanya n’ibigirwamana Bayali na Ashitaroti, bakorera Uhoraho wenyene.
Hanyuma Samweli aravuga ati: “Nkoraniriza Abisirayeli bose i Misipa nanje ndabasengera k’ Uhoraho .”

Bamaze gukoranira i Misipa, bavoma amazi bayasuka imbere y’ Uhoraho . Kuri uwo musi barisonzesha maze baratura bati: “Twaracumuye k’ Uhoraho .” Aho i Misipa ni ho Samweli yakorera nk’umucamanza w’Abisirayeli.
Abafilisitiya bamenye ko Abisirayeli bakoraniye i Misipa, abatware b’Abafilisitiya baca baduga kubatera. Abisirayeli na bo bavyumvise, baca baterwa n’ubwoba bwinshi kubera abo Bafilisitiya.
Babwira Samweli bati: “Ntuhagarike gutakambira Uhoraho Imana yacu ku bwacu, kugira ngo adutabare adukure mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.”
Maze Samweli afata umwagazi w’intama uconka awushikanira wose Uhoraho kw’ikimazi co guturirwa n’umuriro. Atakambira Uhoraho kubw’Abisirayeli, Uhoraho aramwishura.

Samweli agitanga ca kimazi giturirwa n’umuriro, Abafilisitiya barabegereza ngo babahwikire. Ariko kuri uwo musi Uhoraho aturagarira hejuru y’Abafilisitiya nk’umuturagaro ukomeye, bacika ivutu kubera ubwoba, bituma Abisirayeli babatsinda.
Abisirayeli baca bavuduka i Misipa bakurikira Abafilisitiya, bagenda barabicira mu nzira gushika musi y’igisagara ca Beti-Kari.
Maze Samweli afata ibuye arishinga hagati y’i Misipa n’i Sheni, aryita Ebenezeri, bisigura ngo: “Gushika n’ubu Uhoraho aracadutabara.”
Nuko Abafilisitiya baratsindwa ntibasubira kwongera gutera Abisirayeli. Igihe cose Samweli yari akiriho, ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwagumye guhanamiye Abafilisitiya.

Abisirayeli bigarurira ibisagara vyose vyari hagati y’i Ekuroni n’i Gati, ivyo Abafilisitiya bari barabanyaze, kandi Abisirayeli bigarurira n’intara yari ibegereye bayinyaze Abafilisitiya. Haba impore hagati y’Abisirayeli n’Abamori.
Nuko Samweli aguma ari umucamanza w’Abisirayeli imisi yose yabayeho.
Ku mwaka yama afata urugendo akava i Beteli aja i Gilugali gushika i Misipa, acira Abisirayeli imanza muri ivyo bice vyose.
Ariko yama ataha i Rama, ahari urugo rwiwe, kandi n’aho nyene yarahacira imanza z’Abisirayeli. Maze yubakira Uhoraho igicaniro aho nyene.
Samweli ariko arasaza, aha abahungu biwe uburongozi, baba abacamanza b’Abisirayeli.
Imfura yiwe yitwa Yoweli, uwa kabiri akitwa Abiya, kandi bakorera i Berisheba.
Ariko abahungu ba Samweli ntibakurikije akarorero ka se, kuko bakikamye bakarondera inyungu mbi, batangura kurya ibiturire no guca imanza zitabereye.
Nuko abakuru bose bo mu Bisirayeli baja hamwe baja aho Samweli yari ari i Rama.
Baramubwira bati: “Raba urashaje, kandi abana bawe ntibakurikiza akarorero kawe; nuko rero turonderere umwami wo kuturongora, nk’uko bimeze mu yandi mahanga.”
Ariko bamaze kuvuga bati: “Duhe umwami wo kuturongora,” ivyo bibabaza Samweli; aca asenga Uhoraho ngo amusobanuze.
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Niwemere ivyo vyose abantu bariko barakubwira; kuko si wewe banse, ni jewe banse ko nshishikara kuba umwami wabo.
Uko bari bameze kuva igihe nabakura muri Egiputa gushika n’uwu musi, ni ko bakimeze, bama bantera ibitugu bakaja gukorera izindi mana, kandi nawe ni vyo bakugiriye.
Ubu rero bumvirize; ariko ubagabishe, ubamenyeshe neza ivyo umwami azobaganza bazotegerezwa kumukorera.”
Nuko Samweli abwira abo bantu bariko baramusaba umwami amajambo yose Uhoraho yamubwiye.
Ababwira ati: “Ibi ni vyo umwami azobaganza azobasaba ko mumukorera: azofata abahungu banyu abakoreshe ku mikogote no ku mafarasi yiwe, kandi bazohora bama bagenda bariruka imbere y’imikogote yiwe.

Bamwe azobagira abo kuganza abasoda igihumbi, abandi abo kuganza abasoda mirongo itanu gutyo gutyo, abandi babe abo kumurimira amatongo yiwe no kwimbura ivyimburwa vyiwe, kandi abandi bazoba abo gucura ibigwanisho vy’intambara n’ibikoresho vy’imikogote yiwe.
Abakobwa banyu azobatwara babe abo guhingura ibimota neza, abatetsi n’abotsa imikate.
Azotwara imirima, imizabibu n’imyelayo vyanyu vyizavyiza, abihe abamukorera.
Azotwara ikigiracumi c’ingano zanyu n’imizabibu yanyu abihe abishikira biwe n’abamukorera.
Abakozi banyu b’abahungu n’abakobwa n’ivyiza vyo mu nka n’indogoba vyanyu azobitwara abikoreshe ivyiwe.
Azotwara ikigiracumi c’amasho yanyu, kandi namwe ubwanyu muzoba abagurano biwe.
Uwo musi niwashika, muzotaka musaba icobakurako uwo mwami muriko murasaba, ariko Uhoraho ntazobishura.”
Ariko abantu banka kwumviriza Samweli. Baravuga bati: “Oya, dushaka umwami wo kutuganza.
Natwe tuzoca tuba nk’ayandi mahanga, dufise umwami wo kuturongora kandi akatuja imbere tugiye kugwana mu ntambara.”
Maze Samweli yumvise ivyo abantu bavuze vyose, abibwira Uhoraho .
Uhoraho amwishura ati: “Kora ivyo bagusavye ubahe umwami.” Nuko Samweli abwira Abisirayeli ati: “Umuntu wese nasubire mu gisagara ciwe.”
Hariho Umuntu wo mu muryango wa Benyamini, yari atunze, yitwa Kishi wa Abiyeli, Abiyeli wa Zerori, Zerori wa Bekorati, Bekorati wa Afiya, Afiya wa Benyamini.
Uwo Kishi yari afise umuhungu yitwa Sawuli, yari umuhungu mwiza w’akaranga kurusha Abisirayeli bose, kandi no mu burebure yarabasumba bose.
Umusi umwe indogoba za Kishi se wa Sawuli zirazimira, maze Kishi abwira umuhungu wiwe Sawuli ati: “Jana n’umukozi umwe muje kurondera izo ndogoba.”

Nuko baca mu ntara y’imisozi ya Efurayimu no mu karere kegereye Shalisha, ariko ntibazibona. Barabandanya baca mu ntara y’i Shayalimu, ariko izo ndogoba ntizariyo. Nuko baca mu ntara ya Benyamini, ariko ntibazitora.
Bashitse mu karere k’i Zufi, Sawuli abwira wa mukozi bari kumwe ati: “Nuze dusubire inyuma, kuko data yohava areka kwiyumvira indogoba ziwe agatangura guhagarikira umutima twebwe.”
Ariko wa mukozi amwishura ati: “Raba muri iki gisagara hari umuntu w’Imana; arubashwe rwose, kandi ico avuze cose kiba kuno. Reka tujeyo ubu nyene. Kumbure yotubwira inzira dukwiye kujana.”
Sawuli abwira uwo mukozi wiwe ati: “Mbega nitwajayo uwo muntu tumugemurira iki? Ehe indya zaheze mu mifuko yacu! Nta co dufise tugemurira uwo muntu w’Imana. Nta co dusigaranye?”
Uwo mukozi arongera amubwira ati: “Raba ndafise ica kane ca shekeli y’ifeza. Ndaja kugiha uwo muntu w’Imana kugira ngo aturangire inzira dukwiye kujana.”
(Kera muri Isirayeli, iyo umuntu agiye gusiguza Imana, yavuga ati: “Ingo, tuje kuraba uwerekwa,” kuko uwitwa uwuvugishwa n’Imana uno musi, ico gihe yitwa uwerekwa.)
Sawuli abwira umukozi wiwe ati: “Ni vyiza, ingo tugende.” Nuko bagenda batumbereye ico gisagara wa muntu w’Imana yabamwo.
Bakiduga umusozi baja muri ico gisagara, bahura n’abakobwa bavuyeyo bamanutse kuvoma amazi, barababaza bati: “Mbega uwerekwa yoba ari ho ari?”
Barabishura bati: “Ni ho ari. Ari aho imbere yanyu. Nimwihute; ashitse mu gisagara ubu nyene, kuko abantu bateguye gutanga ikimazi hejuru ku musozi.

Nimunyaruke mumushikire ataraja ahabera amazimano. Abantu ntibaja gufungura adashitse, kuko ategerezwa kubanza guhezagira ikimazi; mu nyuma yaho abatumiwe baca bafungura. Nimuduge; muca mumubona mu mwanya.”
Baraduga baja mu gisagara, maze bacinjira, babona Samweli, aza atumbereye aho bari ariko araduga muri ico kibanza kiri hejuru ku musozi.
Ariko umusi umwe imbere y’uko Sawuli aza, Uhoraho yari yiyeretse Samweli amubwira ati:

“Ejo nk’aya masaha nzokurungikira umuntu avuye mu muryango wa Benyamini. Uze umurobanuze amavuta abe umurongozi w’abantu banje b’Abisirayeli; ni we azorokora abantu banje abakure mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya. Nahindukirije inyonga zanje ku bantu banje, kandi ugutakamba kwabo kwanshikiriye.”
Samweli akibona Sawuli, Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Uwo ni wa muntu nakubwira; ni we azorongora abantu banje.”
Sawuli yegera Samweli mw’irembo ry’igisagara aramubaza ati: “Woshobora kundangira inzu y’umwe yerekwa?”

Samweli aramwishura ati: “Ni jewe nyene. Nuduge unyitangire imbere hejuru ku musozi, kuko uno musi uza gusangira nanje, maze mu gitondo nzoca nkubwira ivyo ukeneye kumenya vyose hanyuma nkurekure ugende.
Ku vyerekeye za ndogoba mwabura na zo, hakaba haheze imisi itatu, ntuhagarikwe umutima na zo; bazitoye. Kandi, hari uwundi Abisirayeli bahanze amaso atari wewe n’umuryango wawe?”

Sawuli aramwishura ati: “Ariko, jewe ndi uwo mu muryango wa Benyamini, umuryango mutoya inyuma y’iyindi muri Isirayeli, mbere n’inzu nkomokamwo ni yo ya nyuma mu nzu zigize umuryango wose wa Benyamini! Ni iki gitumye umbwira iryo jambo?”
Nuko Samweli ajana Sawuli n’umukozi wiwe mu nzu abicarika imbere y’abari batumiwe bari nka mirongo itatu.
Samweli abwira umutetsi ati: “Nzanira ya nyama naguha, imwe nakubwira ngo uyishire ku ruhande.”

Nuko wa mutetsi azana ya nyama ayishira imbere ya Sawuli. Samweli aravuga ati: “Ibi ni ivyo twaguteguriye. Fungura, kuko ni wewe vyari vyabikiwe, mbere n’imbere y’uko ntumira aba bandi.” Maze Sawuli asangira na Samweli kuri uwo musi.
Bamaze kumanuka bava kuri wa musozi baja mu gisagara, Samweli adugana Sawuli mu kibanza co hejuru ku nzu yiwe amutegurira aho arara.

Mu mutwenzi baravyuka, maze Samweli ahamagara Sawuli yari akiri muri ca kibanza co hejuru ku nzu, amubwira ati: “Niwitegure, ngomba ndakurungike usubire iwanyu.” Sawuli amaze kwitegura, asohokana na Samweli hanze.

Bariko baramanuka, bageze aho igisagara kigarukira, Samweli abwira Sawuli ati: “Bwira uwo mukozi wawe atwitangire imbere.” Wa mukozi aca akora uko abariwe aragenda. Samweli yongerako ati: “Wewe guma aha akanya gato, kugira ngo nkubwire ubutumwa buvuye ku Mana.”
Nuko Samweli yugurura agacupa karimwo amavuta ya elayo, ayasuka ku mutwe wa Sawuli aca aramusoma, avuga ati: “ Uhoraho akurobanuje amavuta ngo ube umurongozi w’ubwoko bwiwe.

Uno musi nyene, tumaze gutandukana, uraza guhura n’abagabo babiri hafi y’imva ya Rasheli, iri i Zeluza ku rubibe rw’intara ya Benyamini. Na bo baraja kukubwira bati: ‘Za ndogoba mwari mwagiye kurondera zaratowe. Ubu so ntagihagaritswe umutima na zo, ahubwo ahagaritswe umutima na mwebwe. Aguma abaza ico yokora kugira ngo atore umuhungu wiwe.’

Hanyuma uvuye ngaho ukabandanya uzoshikira igiti kinini kiri i Tabori. Uzohura n’abagabo batatu bazoba bariko baraduga i Beteli gusenga Imana. Umwe azoba afise imyagazi y’impene itatu, uwundi imikate itatu, uwundi umukuza ukozwe mu rusato urimwo umuvinyu.
Bazokuramutsa baguhe imikate ibiri, kandi uze uyakire.

Hanyuma uzoshika i Gibeya hitwa ah’Imana, ahari ikambi y’Abafilisitiya. Uri hafi gushika mu gisagara, uzohura n’umugwi w’abavugishwa bavuye ku musozi ahari ikibanza co gusengeramwo, bazoba bafise inanga, udushako tw’ingoma, imyironge n’amakembe, kandi abari imbere yabo bazoba bagenda barabivuza, bongera baravugishwa.
Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho azoca akuzako mu bushobozi, nawe uvugishwe hamwe na bo; kandi uzoca uhinduka ube uwundi muntu.
Ivyo bimenyetso vyose nivyashika, uzoce ukora ikintu cose amaboko yawe ashobora gukora, kuko Imana izoba iri kumwe nawe.

Kandi uze unyitangire imbere kuja i Gilugali. Nanje nzogusangayo nje gutanga ibimazi biturirwa n’umuriro hamwe n’ivy’ishimwe, ariko uze urindire imisi indwi gushika aho nzozira kugira ngo ndakubwire ibindi ukwiye gukora.”
Sawuli ahindukiye ngo atandukane na Samweli, Imana ihindura umutima wiwe, kandi ivyo bimenyetso vyose bishika kuri uwo musi nyene.
Sawuli na wa mukozi wiwe bashitse i Gibeya, bahura n’umugwi w’abavugishwa; Mpwemu w’Imana amuzako mu nkomezi, na we atangura kuvugishwa hamwe na bo.

Abari basanzwe bamuzi bamubonye avugishwa hamwe na ba bavugishwa, barabazanya bati: “Mbega ibi ni ibiki vyabaye kuri mwene Kishi? Mbega burya Sawuli na we yari asanzwe ari mu mugwi w’abavugishwa n’Imana?”
Umwe mu bari ngaho aca arabishura avuga ati: “Mbega abandi bo, ba se ni ba nde?” Ni ho havuye uwu mugani ngo: “Mbega burya na Sawuli nyene arimwo mu bavugishwa?”
Sawuli ahejeje kuvugishwa, aca aduga kuri wa musozi wo gusengerako.

Maze sewabo wa Sawuli abaza Sawuli na wa mukozi wiwe ati: “Mwahora he?” Sawuli amwishura ati: “Twari twagiye kurondera za ndogoba, ariko tubonye ko tudashoboye kuzibona, twaciye tuja kwa Samweli kumusiguza.”
Sewabo aca aramubwira ati: “Mbwira rero ivyo Samweli yakubariye.”
Sawuli yishura sewabo ati: “Yaratumenyesheje ko indogoba zatowe.” Ariko ntiyabwira sewabo ivyo Samweli yavuze bijanye no kuba umwami.
Nuko Samweli ahamagaza Abisirayeli bose ngo bakoranire imbere y’ Uhoraho i Misipa
hanyuma arababwira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: ‘Abisirayeli nabazanye ndabakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, ndabakura mu bubasha bw’Abanyegiputa n’ubw’abandi bami babacinyiza.’

Ariko mwateye ibitugu Imana yanyu, kandi ari yo ibakiza ivyago n’ibiza vyose. Hanyuma mwavuze muti: ‘Oya, duhe umwami wo kutuganza.’ Nuko rero nimuze muhagarare imbere y’ Uhoraho uko imiryango n’amazu ya ba sogokuruza banyu biri.”
Maze Samweli amaze kwegeranya imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli, umuryango wa Benyamini aba ari wo werekanwa n’ubupfindo.
Nuko azana umuryango wa Benyamini uko amazu ya ba sekuruza ari, inzu ya Matirite aba ari yo yerekanwa. Mu nyuma Sawuli mwene Kishi aba ari we yerekanwa. Ariko bamurondeye, ntiyaboneka.
Nuko basiguza Uhoraho bati: “Mbega uwo muntu yoba araza hano?” Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Egome, yinyegeje mu mizigo.”
Nuko baragenda bamukurayo, kandi ahagaze mu bantu akabaruta mu burebure bose.
Samweli abwira abantu ati: “Murabona umuntu Uhoraho yatoranije? Nta n’umwe ameze nka we mu bantu bose.” Nuko abantu bose biha akamo bati: “Umwami arakaramba!”
Samweli asigurira abantu ivyo umwami asabwa gukora n’ivyo akorerwa, aca avyandika mu gitabu agishira imbere y’ Uhoraho . Nuko Samweli arungika abantu, umwe wese ataha iwe.
Na Sawuli ataha iwe i Gibeya, aherekejwe n’abahizi Imana yakoze ku mitima.
Ariko abantu b’imburakimazi baravuga bati: “Uwu mugabo yodukiza gute?” Baramukengera ntibamuzanira amashikanwa. Ariko Sawuli arinumira.

Inyuma y’ivyo, umwami w’Abamoni Nahashi araduga atera igisagara ca Isirayeli citwa Yabeshi Gileyadi. Abantu b’i Yabeshi baramwinginga bati: “Turagusavye tugiriranire amasezerano, utureke tube abasavyi bawe.”
Ariko Nahashi umwami w’Abamoni abishura ati: “Ndemera ko tugiriranira amasezerano, ariko mbanza kunogora umuntu wese wo muri mwebwe ijisho ry’i buryo kugira ngo Abisirayeli bose babe ibimaramare.”
Abakuru b’i Yabeshi baramubwira bati: “Turindire imisi indwi tubanze turungike intumwa mu Bisirayeli bose; nihataboneka n’umwe wo kudutabara, tuzoca tukwishikanira udukoze ico ugomba.”
Nuko intumwa zija i Gibeya, igisagara Sawuli yabamwo, zibwira abantu ayo majambo y’umwami w’Abamoni; maze bose baca baraturikisha bararira n’ijwi rirenga.
Sawuli na we yariko arava mu mirima, ashoreye inka ziwe zirima. Arabaza ati: “Habaye iki? Ni kubera iki abantu bose bariko bararira?” Baca bamusubiriramwo ivyo abo bantu b’i Yabeshi bababwiye.
Sawuli yumvise ayo majambo, Mpwemu w’Imana amuzako mu nkomezi nyinshi, aca arashavura cane.

Afata inka zirima zibiri, azicagaguramwo ibihimba, abirungikana intumwa mu gihugu cose ca Isirayeli, n’ubutumwa buvuga ngo: “Uku ni ko inka z’umuntu wese atazokurikira Sawuli na Samweli mu ntambara zizohimbagurwa.” Nuko ubwoba buvuye k’ Uhoraho bufata abantu, baca bakoranira hamwe nk’umuntu umwe.
Igihe Sawuli yabegeraniriza hamwe i Bezeki, abagabo b’Abisirayeli bari ibihumbi amajana atatu, abagabo b’i Buyuda na bo bari ibihumbi mirongo itatu.

Babwira za ntumwa zari zaje ziva i Yabeshi bati: “Mubwire abantu b’i Yabeshi Gileyadi muti: ‘Ejo mu gihe c’amashoka, muzotabarwa.’ ” Za ntumwa ziragenda zimenyesha abantu b’i Yabeshi iyo nkuru, na bo baranezerwa cane.
Baca babwira Abamoni bati: “Ejo tuzokwishikana mu maboko yanyu, namwe muze mudukoze ico mugomba cose.”

Bukeye Sawuli agabura abantu biwe mu mice itatu; maze hakiri mw’ijoro, ariko bugiye guca, bashika giturumbuka aho Abamoni bacumbitse babamarisha inkota igitondo cose kugeza mu gihe c’amashoka. Abacitse kw’icumu barasanzara, kugeza aho ata bantu babiri bashoboye guhunga bari kumwe.
Maze abantu baca babwira Samweli bati: “Ni ba nde bavuze ngo: ‘Aho Sawuli arakwiye kutuganza?’ Batuzanire tubice!”
Ariko Sawuli aravuga ati: “Nta muntu n’umwe yicwa kuri uno musi, kuko ari umusi Uhoraho yatabaye Abisirayeli.”
Nuko Samweli abwira abantu ati: “Nimuze tuje i Gilugali dusubire gukomeza ivy’ubwami.”

Nuko abantu bose baja i Gilugali, bemeza Sawuli ko ari umwami imbere y’ Uhoraho . Baca batangira aho nyene imbere y’ Uhoraho ibimazi vy’ishimwe, maze Sawuli n’Abisirayeli bose bagira umusi mukuru ukomeye.

headings.text: Sawuli atabara abo mu gisagara c’i Yabeshi

verses.text: Samweli abwira Abisirayeli ati: “Narumvise ivyo mwambariye vyose none namaze kubaha umwami wo kubaganza.
Ubu rero murafise umwami wo kubarongora. Jewe ndashaje, mfise imvi, mbere n’abahungu banje bari ngaha muri mwebwe. Nabaye umurongozi wanyu kuva nkiri muto gushika uno musi.

None mpagaze hano. Nimunyagirize imbere y’ Uhoraho n’uwo yimikishije amavuta. Ni nde nanyaze inka yiwe? Ni nde nanyaze indogoba yiwe? Ni nde nagunze? Ni nde nacinyije? Ni nde yampaye igiturire kugira ngo kimpume amaso? Nihaba hari ikintu na kimwe kinyagira muri ivyo vyose, ndagitunganya.”
Baramwishura bati: “Ntiwatugunze, ntiwaducinyije kandi nta n’umwe wanyaze ikintu na kimwe.”

Samweli arabishura ati: “ Uhoraho ni we cabona imbere yanyu hamwe n’uwo yimikishije amavuta ko ata na kimwe munyagiriza, amaboko yanje yoba yariyandurishije.” Baramwishura bati: “Ni vyo, Uhoraho ni we cabona.”
Nuko Samweli abwira abantu ati: “ Uhoraho ni we yatoranije Mose na Aroni kandi ni we yakuye ba sogokuruza banyu muri Egiputa.
Nuko rero, nimuze hano imbere y’ Uhoraho ndabibutse ivyiza vyose yabakoreye mwebwe na ba sogokuruza banyu.
Yakobo n’abiwe bamaze gushika muri Egiputa, ba sogokuruza banyu batakambiye Uhoraho ngo abatabare, maze Uhoraho atuma Mose na Aroni, baba ari bo babakura muri Egiputa babashira muri iki gihugu.
Ariko baciye bibagira Uhoraho Imana yabo; bituma abarekurira mu maboko ya Sisera, umukuru w’ingabo z’i Hazori, no mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya n’umwami w’i Mowabu barabagwanya.
Maze batakambira Uhoraho bavuga bati: ‘Twaracumuye; twataye Uhoraho dukorera Bayali na Ashitaroti. Ariko niwadutabara ukadukiza amaboko y’abansi bacu ubu, natwe tuzogukorera.’
Nuko Uhoraho arungika Yerubayili, Baraki, Yefuta na Samweli, abakura mu maboko y’abansi banyu impande zose, muca muba mu mahoro.
Ariko mubonye Nahashi umwami w’Abamoni aje kubatera, muraza mumbwira muti: ‘Tugomba umwami wo kutuganza,’ kandi Uhoraho Imana yanyu yari asanzwe ari umwami wanyu.
None rero ng’uwu umwami mwahisemwo, uwo mwasavye; raba Uhoraho yabahaye umwami wo kubaganza.
Nimwubaha Uhoraho , mukamukorera, mukamwumvira ntimugararize amabwirizwa yiwe; mwebwe n’umwami abatwara nimwakurikira Uhoraho Imana yanyu bizoba ari vyiza.
Ariko nimutubaha Uhoraho , mukagarariza amabwirizwa yiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzobahanamira, nk’uko kwahanamiye ba sogokuruza banyu.
Ubu rero, nimuhagarare mushikamye, murabe ikintu gihambaye Uhoraho agira akorere imbere y’amaso yanyu!

Mbega ubu si mw’iyimbura ry’ingano? Murazi ko ata mvura isanzwe igwa. Ngira nambaze Uhoraho na we ararekura imituragaro n’imvura. Hanyuma muratahura ikibi mwakoze imbere y’inyonga z’ Uhoraho mu kwubahuka kumusaba umwami.”
Nuko Samweli yambaza Uhoraho . Kuri uwo musi nyene Uhoraho arungika imituragaro n’imvura, bituma abantu bose bafatwa n’ubwoba bwinshi, batinya Uhoraho na Samweli.
Abantu bose babwira Samweli bati: “Dusabire k’ Uhoraho Imana yawe twebwe abasavyi bawe kugira ngo ntidupfe, kuko kuri vya vyaha vyacu vyose, twongeyeko ikindi kibi co gusaba umwami.”
Samweli arabishura ati: “Ntimutinye. Egome mwarakoze ivyo bibi vyose, ariko ntimusubire gutera ibitugu Uhoraho , ariko mumukorere n’imitima yanyu yose.
Ntimusubire guhindukirira ibigirwamana bitagira ikimazi. Ntibishobora kubakorera iciza na kimwe, canke ngo bibakize, kuko bitagira ikimazi.
Ku bw’icubahiro c’izina ryiwe rihambaye, Uhoraho ntazota abantu biwe, kuko Uhoraho vyamuhimbaye kubagira ihanga yiharije.
Kandi jewe, ntibikambeko ko nocumura k’ Uhoraho mu kureka kubasengera. Nzoshishikara kubigisha ivyiza n’ibigororotse.
Ariko muze mwubahe Uhoraho , mumukorere mu bwizigirwa n’imitima yanyu yose, mwibuke ibihambaye vyose yabakoreye.
Ariko nimwashishikara gukora ibibi, mwebwe n’umwami wanyu muzohona mwese.”
Sawuli yari amaze imyaka mirongo itatu igihe yaba umwami, hanyuma aganza Abisirayeli imyaka mirongo ine n’ibiri.

Sawuli atoranya abasoda ibihumbi bitatu mu Bisirayeli; abasigaye abarungika iwabo. Muri abo yahisemwo, atoramwo ibihumbi bibiri bajana na we i Mikimashi, mu ntara y’imisozi ya Beteli, abandi igihumbi bajana n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani i Gibeya mu ntara ya Benyamini. Abasigaye bose abarungika iwabo.

Umusi umwe, Yonatani atera ikirindiro c’Abafilisitiya cari i Geba aragitsinda, maze Abafilisitiya bose baravyumva. Nuko Sawuli asaba ko bavuza inzamba mu gihugu cose, avuga ati: “Nimubimenyeshe Abaheburayo bose!”

Nuko Abisirayeli bose bumva iyo nkuru ngo: “Sawuli yateye ikirindiro c’Abafilisitiya aragisambura, none Abafilisitiya banka Abisirayeli urwanko rukomeye.” Nuko abasoda bose barahamagarana basanga Sawuli i Gilugali.

Abafilisitiya na bo bakoranira hamwe ngo batere Abisirayeli, bafise imikogote ibihumbi bitatu n’abagendera ku mikogote ibihumbi bitandatu, n’abasoda bangana n’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga. Nuko baraduga bacumbika i Mikimashi, mu buseruko bwa Beti-Aveni.
Abisirayeli babonye ko bibakomeranye, kuko bari bazigirijwe, baja kwinyegeza mu masenga, mu myobo, mu bitandara, no mu binogo vyimbiwe kubika amazi.
Bamwe mu Baheburayo barahunga bajabuka Yorodani baja mu ntara ya Gadi na Gileyadi. Sawuli aguma i Gilugali, kandi abasoda bose bari kumwe na we bariko barajugumira kubera ubwoba.
Nuko Sawuli arindira Samweli imisi indwi, nk’uko Samweli yari yamubwiye; ariko Samweli ntiyaza i Gilugali; maze abasoda batangura guta Sawuli barashwiragira.
Sawuli aravuga ati: “Nimunzanire ca kimazi co gutongozwa umuriro na vya bimazi vy’ishimwe.” Nuko Sawuli atanga ca kimazi co gutongozwa umuriro.
Agiheza kugitanga, Samweli aca arashika, maze Sawuli asohoka kumusanganira.
Samweli aramubaza ati: “Ibi wakoze ni ibiki?” Sawuli arishura ati: “Nabonye abantu bariko barashwiragira, nawe mbona ntiwubahirije isango, kandi Abafilisitiya bariko bariyegeraniriza i Mikimashi,
nca ndibaza nti: ‘Abafilisitiya bahava bamanuka kuntera i Gilugali, basange ntarambaza Uhoraho ngo antabare.’ Nuko nca numva notanga jewe nyene ikimazi co gutongozwa umuriro.”
Samweli aramubwira ati: “Wakoze ivy’ubupfu. Kuko ntiwumviye ibwirizwa Uhoraho Imana yaguhaye; iyo uryumvira yotumye ingoma yawe ihoraho ibihe vyose mu Bisirayeli.
Ariko noneho ubwami bwawe ntibuzoramba; Uhoraho yamaze kwironkera umuntu ameze nk’uko umutima wiwe ugomba ngo amwimike abe umurongozi w’abantu biwe, kuko utumviye ico Uhoraho yagutegetse.”
Nuko Samweli ava i Gilugali aduga i Gibeya mu ntara ya Benyamini. Sawuli aharura abasoda bari bakiri kumwe na we, asanga ni hafi amajana atandatu.
Sawuli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani hamwe n’abasoda bari kumwe na bo bacumbika i Gibeya mu ntara ya Benyamini, mu gihe Abafilisitiya bari bacumbitse i Mikimashi.
Umusi umwe, umugwi w’abasoda b’Abafilisitiya b’abahinga mu kugwana urasohoka uva aho ingabo zabo zicumbitse, bigabura mu mice itatu. Umuce umwe ugenda utumbereye i Ofura mu karere ka Shuwali,
uwundi uja i Beti-Horoni, uwa gatatu ugenda werekeye ku rubibe, haruguru y’ikiyaya c’i Zeboyime aharabana n’ubugaragwa.
Muri ico gihe nta mucuzi yaboneka mu gihugu ca Isirayeli, kuko Abafilisitiya bavuga bati: “Abaheburayo bohava bacura inkota canke amacumu!”
Ni co gituma Abisirayeli bose iyo bakeneye gukarisha isuka inka zirimisha, isuka isanzwe, incabiti canke umuhoro, babijana ku bacuzi b’Abafilisitiya.

Igiciro cari bibiri vya bitatu vya shekeli kugira ngo bakarishe isuka inka zirimisha, isuka isanzwe; n’ica gatatu ca shekeli kugira ngo bakarishe incabiti, umuhoro, canke kugira ngo basongore ikimito.
Nuko ku musi w’intambara nta musoda n’umwe mu bari kumwe na Sawuli canke Yonatani yari afise inkota canke icumu mu minwe. Sawuli n’umuhungu wiwe Yonatani bonyene ni bo bari babifise.
Hanyuma umuce umwe w’Abafilisitiya uja gutegera ku nzira ica i Mikimashi.
Umusi umwe Yonatani mwene Sawuli abwira umuhungu yamutwaza ibigwanisho ati: “Ingo, tuje ku kirindiro c’Abafilisitiya hariya hakurya.” Ariko ntiyabibwira se wiwe.
Sawuli yari ku rubibe rw’i Gibeya yicaye musi y’igiti c’amakomamanga kiri i Miguroni. Yari kumwe n’abasoda amajana atandatu,

muri bo harimwo Ahiya, yari yambaye Efodi. Ahiya yari mwene Ahitubu yavukana na Ikabodi mwene Finehasi, Finehasi mwene Eli, umuherezi w’ Uhoraho w’i Shilo. Mu basoda, nta n’umwe yigeze amenya ko Yonatani yagiye.
Mu kuja kuri ico kirindiro c’Abafilisitiya, Yonatani yari yaciye mu nzira iri hagati y’ibitandara bibiri, kimwe citwa Bozezi, ikindi Senehi.
Kimwe cari mu buraruko werekeye i Mikimashi, ikindi mu bumanuko werekeye i Gibeya.

Yonatani abwira wa musore amutwaza ibigwanisho ati: “Ingo tujabuke hakurya kuri kirya kirindiro ca zirya ntakebwa. Kumbure Uhoraho yogira ico adukoreye. Nta cobuza Uhoraho gukiza abantu, akoresheje benshi canke akoresheje bake.”
Uwo amutwaza ibigwanisho aramubwira ati: “Kora ico wumva kibereye, nanje ndi kumwe nawe muri vyose.”
Yonatani aravuga ati: “Ingo rero tujabuke dutumbereye barya bagabo kandi tugende batubona.
Nibatubwira bati: ‘Rindira tubasange aho mugeze,’ duca tuguma aho tugeze, ntitubasangayo.
Ariko nibatubwira bati: ‘Nimuduge mudusange ino,’ duca tuduga, kuko kizoba ari ikimenyetso ko Uhoraho abagabuye mu maboko yacu.”
Nuko bompi bagenda abari ku kirindiro c’Abafilisitiya bababona. Abafilisitiya baravuga bati: “Ehe Abaheburayo bariko baranyeguruka bava mu myobo bari binyegejemwo.”

Ba bantu bari kuri ico kirindiro barasemerera babwira Yonatani n’uwari amutwaje ibigwanisho bati: “Nimuduge hano tubereke!” Nuko Yonatani abwira umwe amutwaje ibigwanisho ati: “Nkurikira tuduge; Uhoraho abagabuye mu maboko y’Abisirayeli.”
Yonatani aduga aharamba n’amaboko n’amaguru, umwe amutwaje ibigwanisho amukurikiye. Yonatani agenda atera Abafilisitiya bagwa imbere yiwe, umwe amutwaje ibigwanisho na we akagenda arabahohosha.
Muri ico gitero ca mbere Yonatani n’uwari amutwaje ibigwanisho bica abagabo mirongo ibiri, imivyimba yabo yandagara ahantu hangana n’ahorimwa n’inka zibiri ku musi.

Maze ubwoba bufata ingabo zose z’Abafilisitiya: abasigaye aho bacumbitse, abari mu mirima, abari ku birindiro hamwe n’imice yagiye gutera yose. Isi iranyiganyiga, haba ubwoba bukomeye burungitswe n’Imana.
Abareretsi ba Sawuli bari i Gibeya mu ntara ya Benyamini babona ingabo z’Abafilisitiya ziruka zishwiragira impande zose.
Nuko Sawuli abwira abari kumwe na we ati: “Koranya ingabo zose turabe uwatuvuyemwo.” Baravye, basanga Yonatani n’uwumutwaza ibigwanisho ni bo bari babuze.
Sawuli abwira Ahiya ati: “Zana Isandugu y’Imana.” (Muri ico gihe yari ifiswe n’Abisirayeli.)
Sawuli akivugana n’umuherezi, urwamo rurushaho kuba rwinshi mu ngabo z’Abafilisitiya. Nuko Sawuli abwira wa muherezi Ahiya ati: “Isigireho kwinginga Uhoraho .”
Nuko Sawuli n’ingabo zari kumwe na we barakorana baja kugwana. Basanga Abafilisitiya bari mu muvurungano ukomeye, umwe wese acumita inkota mugenziwe.
Mbere n’Abaheburayo bari bagiye kwishikana ku Bafilisitiya kandi bari kumwe na bo aho bacumbitse barahindukira baja ku ruhande rw’Abisirayeli bari kumwe na Sawuli na Yonatani.
Abisirayeli bari binyegeje mu karere k’imisozi k’Abefurayimu bumvise ko Abafilisitiya bariko barahunga, babaja inyuma barabagwanya.
Nuko kuri uwo musi, Uhoraho atabara Abisirayeli, kandi urugamba rurabandanya gushika barenze i Beti-Aveni.

Kuri uwo musi Abisirayeli bari bacitse intege kubera kuruha, kuko Sawuli yari yarahije abantu ati: “Aravumwe umuntu aza kugira ico arya butarira, ntarihora abansi banje!” Rero nta muntu n’umwe mu bari ku rugamba yigeze agira ico ashira ku munwa.
Ingabo zose zirenguka ahantu hari ishamba, zisanga hatemba ubuki.
Binjiye mw’ishamba, babona ubuki buriko buratemba, kandi ata n’umwe yigeze abukorako ngo ashire ku munwa, kuko batinya ya ndahiro.
Ariko Yonatani we ntiyari yumvise ko se yarahije abantu, aca ashira inkoni yari yitwaje mu kimamara c’ubuki. Araheza aratamira, intege ziragaruka.
Umwe mu bakuru b’ingabo aramubwira ati: “So yarahije ingabo zose ngo: ‘Aravumwe umuntu wese aza kugira ico ariye uwu musi!’ Ni co gituma abantu bacitse intege.”
Yonatani aravuga ati: “Data yateye amakuba mu gihugu. Raba ingene intege zigarutse maze kurigata kuri ubu buki.
Mbega ntivyari kuba vyiza kurushiriza iyo abantu baba bariye ku vyo banyaze abansi babo? Kandi tuba twarushirijeho kunesha Abafilisitiya.”
Kuri uwo musi, Abisirayeli bamaze kunesha Abafilisitiya kuva i Mikimashi gushika i Ayaloni, bagera aho bacika intege kubera kuruha.
Nuko basimbira ku vyo basahuye, bafata intama, amashuri n’inyana z’inka, babibagira aho nyene bari, baca babirya bikirimwo amaraso.

Umuntu umwe abwira Sawuli ati: “Ehe raba abantu bariko baracumura k’ Uhoraho kuko bariko bararya inyama zikirimwo amaraso.” Sawuli aravuga ati: “Mwahemutse! Nimunyarukane ibuye rinini hano ubu nyene.”

Nuko aravuga ati: “Nimugende murondere abantu mubabwire umuntu wese azane hano inka yiwe canke intama yiwe, babibagire kandi babirire hano. Nimureke gucumura k’ Uhoraho mu kurya inyama zikirimwo amaraso.” Nuko umuntu wese azana ishuri yiwe muri iryo joro ayibagira ngaho.
Maze Sawuli yubakira Uhoraho igicaniro; kandi bwari ubwa mbere akora atyo.

Sawuli aravuga ati: “Nimuze tumanuke dukurikire Abafilisitiya mw’ijoro tubanyage ivyabo gushika mu mutwenzi, kandi ntidusigaze n’umwe ari muzima.” Na bo barishura bati: “Nukore ivyo ubona ko ari vyiza.” Ariko umuherezi aravuga ati: “Reka dusigurize Imana ngaha nyene.”
Nuko Sawuli abaza Uhoraho ati: “Mbega manuke nkurikire Abafilisitiya? Urabagabura mu maboko y’Abisirayeli?” Ariko Imana ntiyamwishura kuri uwo musi.
Nuko Sawuli aravuga ati: “Nimuze hano mwebwe mwese murongoye abasoda, kugira ngo tugire ubupfindo tumenye icaha cakozwe uwu musi.
Kandi ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho atabara Abisirayeli, naho yoba ari umwana wanje Yonatani, ategerezwa gupfa.” Ariko nta n’umwe mu bantu yagize ico avuga.
Nuko Sawuli abwira Abisirayeli bose ati: “Nimuhagarare harya; nanje n’umuhungu wanje Yonatani duhagarare hano.” Abantu barishura bati: “Nukore ikiguhimbaye cose.”

Nuko Sawuli asenga Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli ati: “Ni igiki catumye utanyishura jewe umusavyi wawe uno musi? Nimba vyavuye ku caha nakoze canke umuhungu wanje Yonatani yakoze, ndakwinginze wishure na Urimu, ariko nimba vyavuye ku caha c’abasoda ba Isirayeli, ndakwinginze wishure na Tumimu.” Maze Yonatani na Sawuli baba ari bo bafatwa n’ubupfindo, abasoda bo barera.
Sawuli aravuga ati: “Mugire ubupfindo hagati yanje na Yonatani umuhungu wanje.” Maze Yonatani aba ari we afatwa.
Maze Sawuli abwira Yonatani ati: “Mbwira ico wakoze.” Yonatani aramubwira ati: “Narigase ubuki bukeya ndabuhakuje inkoni yanje. None ntegerezwa gupfa!”
Sawuli aravuga ati: “Imana ize ibimpore mbere birushirije, nutapfa, Yonatani.”

Ariko abasoda baravuga bati: “Mbega Yonatani yopfa ari we yazanye ugutabarwa kungana gutya mu Bisirayeli? Ntibikabe! Turahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , nta n’agashatsi ko ku mutwe wiwe kaza gukorokera hasi, kuko yakoze ivyo uno musi afashijwe n’Imana.” Nuko abantu bakiza Yonatani batyo, maze ntiyicwa.
Nuko Sawuli areka gukurikira Abafilisitiya, na bo basubira mu gihugu cabo.
Kuva Sawuli ahawe kuganza Abisirayeli, yagwanye n’abansi b’impande zose: Abanyamowabu, Abamoni, Abanyedomu, abami b’i Zoba, n’Abafilisitiya. Kandi aho yaja kugwana hose, yama atahukana intsinzi.
Yagwananye ubuhizi anesha Abamaleki, akura Abisirayeli mu maboko y’abari barabanyaze ivyabo.
Bene Sawuli bari Yonatani, Ishuvi na Maluki-Shuwa. Umukobwa wiwe mukuru yitwa Merabi, mutoya na we yitwa Mikali.
Umugore wiwe yitwa Ahinowamu umukobwa wa Ahimazi. Umukuru w’ingabo za Sawuli yitwa Abuneri mwene Neri, Neri na we yari sewabo wa Sawuli.
Kishi se wa Sawuli na Neri se wa Abuneri bari bene Abiyeli.
Imyaka yose Sawuli yamaze ku ngoma yari iy’intambara zikomeye yagwanye n’Abafilisitiya, kandi igihe cose Sawuli yabona umuntu w’intwari canke w’umuhizi, yaca amushira mu ngabo ziwe.
Umusi umwe, Samweli abwira Sawuli ati: “Ni jewe Uhoraho yatumye kukurobanuza amavuta ngo ube umwami w’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli; niwumve rero ijambo ngiye kukubwira rivuye k’ Uhoraho .
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Ngomba guhana Abamaleki kubera ivyo bakoreye Abisirayeli igihe babategera mu nzira bavuye muri Egiputa.
Nuko rero genda utere Abamaleki kandi urandure ikintu cose. Ntihagire ico usigaza; wice abagabo n’abagore, abana n’inzoya, inka n’intama, ingamiya n’indogoba.’ ”

Nuko Sawuli atumako abagize ingabo bose, abakoraniriza i Telayimu, bose hamwe bari abasoda ibihumbi amajana abiri bavuye mu miryango ya Isirayeli hamwe n’ibihumbi cumi bavuye mu muryango wa Yuda wonyene.
Nuko Sawuli ajana n’ingabo ziwe gutera igisagara c’Abamaleki, binyegeza mu mwonga kugira ngo babatere giturumbuka.
Maze abwira Abakayini ati: “Mwebwe nimwitandukanye n’Abamaleki kugira ngo ntimuranduranwe na bo; kuko mwagiriye neza Abisirayeli igihe bava muri Egiputa.” Nuko Abakayini bitandukanya n’Abamaleki.
Hanyuma Sawuli atera Abamaleki kuva i Havila gushika i Shuri, mu buseruko bwa Egiputa.
Afata Agagi umwami w’Abamaleki, abantu biwe bose abaranduza inkota.

Ariko Sawuli n’ingabo ziwe basigaza Agagi n’ibitungwa vyizavyiza vyo mu ntama n’inka, inyana zivyibushe n’imyagazi y’intama, eka ibintu vyose vyiza, ibikengeretse n’ibinyantegenke vyose baba ari vyo barandura.
Maze Uhoraho abwira Samweli ati:
“Ndicujije icatumye nimika Sawuli ngo abe umwami, kuko yanteye ibitugu ntakurikize ivyo namutegetse.” Samweli arababara cane, atakambira Uhoraho iryo joro ryose.
Mu gitondo ca kare Samweli aravyuka aja kubonana na Sawuli, ariko baramubwira bati: “Sawuli yagiye i Karumeli gushinga icibutso ciwe co kumuhesha icubahiro hanyuma aca aramanuka aja i Gilugali.”
Samweli amushikiriye, Sawuli amubwira ati: “ Uhoraho aguhezagire! Ivyo Uhoraho yantegetse gukora vyose, nabikoze.”
Samweli aramwishura ati: “None ko numva ukwabira kw’intama n’inka mu matwi yanje?”

Sawuli aramwishura ati: “Ni intama n’inka nziza kurusha izindi abasoda basigaje barabizana babikuye mu Bamaleki kugira ngo babishikanire Uhoraho Imana yawe, ariko ibindi vyose twarabiranduye turabimara.”
Samweli abwira Sawuli ati: “Geza aho! Nyumviriza nkubwire ico Uhoraho yaraye ambwiye muri iri joro rikeye.” Sawuli aramwishura ati: “Mbwira.”
Samweli amubwira ati: “Naho wewe nyene wari wariravye ukikengera, mbega ntiwabaye umurongozi w’imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli? Uhoraho yarakurobanuje amavuta ngo ube umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Kandi yaragutumye, arakubwira ati: ‘Genda urandure abo bantu babi b’Abamaleki, ubagwanye gushika ubamaze bose.’
None ni iki catumye utumvira Uhoraho ? Ni kuki wagurukiye ku vyanyazwe ugakora ikintu kibi nk’ico mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho ?”
Ariko Sawuli ashishikara avuga ati: “Narakoze igikorwa Uhoraho yantumye. Naranduye Abamaleki bose, mfata n’umwami wabo Agagi ndamuzana.
Abasoda ni bo bafashe intama n’inka mu vyanyazwe, ivyo babonye ko ari vyiza kurusha ibindi kugira ngo babishikanire Uhoraho Imana yawe kw’ibimazi i Gilugali.”

Ariko Samweli aramwishura ati: “Mbega Uhoraho ahimbarwa n’amashikanwa atongozwa umuriro n’ibimazi kuruta kumwumvira no gukora ico yategetse? Nyumviriza! Kwumvira Uhoraho biruta ibimazi, kandi kwumvira ico yavuze biruta amapfizi y’intama anuze.
Kuko kugarariza ari co kimwe n’icaha c’ubupfumu, kandi ukutumvira, ni co kimwe n’ugusenga ibigirwamana. Ko wanse kwumvira ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , na we yanse ko ubandanya uri umwami.”
Nuko Sawuli abwira Samweli ati: “Ni vyo, nacumuye. Nanse kwumvira ivyo Uhoraho yantegetse n’ivyo yanyihanikirije. Natinye abantu nca ndabemerera gukora ivyo bashaka.
None rero, ndakwinginze, mparira icaha canje, hanyuma uze dusubirane inyuma, kugira ngo nje gusenga Uhoraho .”
Ariko Samweli aramubwira ati: “Sinsubirana inyuma nawe. Wanse kwumvira ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , na we yanse ko uba umwami w’Abisirayeli!”
Samweli ahindukiye ngo agende, Sawuli amufata ku musozo w’ikanzu yambaye ica iratabuka.
Samweli aca amubwira ati: “ Uhoraho atabuye ubwami bwa Isirayeli arabukwatse kuva uwu musi, abuhaye uwundi akurusha ubutwari.
Uhoraho, we Cubahiro ca Isirayeli, ntiyigera abesha kandi ntiyivuguruza; kuko si umwana w’umuntu ngo aje arihindukiza mw’ijambo.”
Sawuli aramwishura ati: “Ni vyo nacumuye. Ariko ndakwinginze ntera iteka imbere y’aba bakuru b’abantu banje n’imbere y’Abisirayeli; garuka tujane, kugira ngo nsenge Uhoraho Imana yawe.”
Nuko Samweli asubiranayo na Sawuli, Sawuli asenga Uhoraho .
Maze Samweli aravuga ati: “Nzanira Agagi umwami w’Abamaleki.” Maze Agagi aza aho Samweli ari aremye, yibaza ati: “Singipfuye.”
Ariko Samweli aravuga ati: “Nk’uko inkota yawe yahekuye abavyeyi benshi, ni ko na nyoko abaye umwe muri abo bagore bahekuwe.” Maze Samweli ahimbagurira Agagi aho nyene imbere y’ Uhoraho i Gilugali.
Nuko Samweli asubira i Rama, ariko Sawuli araduga aja iwe i Gibeya.
Samweli ntiyigeze asubira kubonana na Sawuli kugeza apfuye, naho yagandaye kubera umubabaro w’ivyabaye kuri Sawuli. Kandi Uhoraho yaricujije icatumye yimika Sawuli ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli.

Uhoraho abwira Samweli ati: “Mbega uzogeza ryari kugandarira Sawuli, uwo nanse ko aba umwami w’Abisirayeli? Uzuza amavuta ihembe ryawe uce ufata inzira; uje kwa Isayi, i Betelehemu. Natoranije umwe mu bahungu biwe ngo abe umwami.”
Ariko Samweli aravuga ati: “Mbega nobigenza gute? Sawuli avyumvise yonyica.” Uhoraho amubwira ati: “Uze ujane ishashi y’inka uvuge uti: ‘Nje gushikanira ikimazi Uhoraho .’
Uze utumire Isayi aze ku kimazi, hanyuma nanje nzokubwira ico uri bukore. Uze urobanuze amavuta uwo nzokwereka.”
Samweli akora nk’uko Uhoraho amubariye. Ashitse i Betelehemu, abakuru b’igisagara bahagarika umutima bamubonye. Baramubaza bati: “Uzanywe n’amahoro?”
Samweli arabishura ati: “Egome ni amahoro; nzanywe no gushikanira ikimazi Uhoraho . Nimwiyeze muze dutange ikimazi.” Nuko yeza Isayi n’abahungu biwe abatumira ku kimazi.
Bashitse, Samweli abona Eliyabu, maze ariyumvira ati: “Ni ukuri uwu ni we Uhoraho yatoranije.”
Ariko Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Nturabe akaranga n’uburebure, uwo namwanse. Uhoraho ntaraba ku vyo abantu baraba. Abantu baraba ku biboneka, ariko Uhoraho araba mu mutima.”
Nuko Isayi ahamagara Abinadabu amucisha imbere ya Samweli. Ariko Samweli aravuga ati: “N’uwu si we Uhoraho yahisemwo.”
Isayi azana Shama, Samweli aravuga ati: “N’uwu na we si we Uhoraho yahisemwo.”
Isayi acisha abahungu biwe indwi imbere ya Samweli, ariko Samweli aramubwira ati: “ Uhoraho ntiyahisemwo n’umwe muri aba.”

Nuko aramubaza ati: “Aba ni bo bahungu ufise?” Isayi aramwishura ati: “Harasigaye umuhererezi, kandi ubu ari kuragira intama.” Samweli aramubwira ati: “Mutumeko; kuko tuticara ngo dufungure atarashika.”
Nuko amutumako araza. Yari umusore akeye mu maso, afise amaso meza kandi w’akaranga. Nuko Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Haguruka umusukeko amavuta; ni uwo nyene.”
Maze Samweli yakira rya hembe ry’amavuta ayamusukako bakuru biwe babona, kandi kuva uwo musi n’inyuma y’aho Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho yama aza kuri Dawidi azananye ubushobozi. Nuko Samweli asubira i Rama.
Ico gihe, Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho yari amaze kuva kuri Sawuli, maze impwemu mbi itumwe n’ Uhoraho ikaza ikamubuza amahoro.
Abishikira ba Sawuli baragenda bamubwira bati: “Ehe raba impwemu mbi ivuye ku Mana irakubujije amahoro.
Reka, turondere umuntu ashobora kukuvugiriza inanga. Azoja arayivuza igihe cose iyo mpwemu mbi itumwe n’Imana igufashe, kandi kuva ako kanya uzoca umererwa neza.”
Nuko Sawuli abwira abo bishikira biwe ati: “Ndonderera uwo muntu azi kuvuza neza inanga mumunzanire.”

Umwe mu bakozi biwe aravuga ati: “Narabonye umwe muri bene Isayi w’i Betelehemu azi kuvuza inanga neza. Ni umuntu w’intwari, akerebutse w’umuhizi mu ntambara. Avuga neza, ni umunyakaranga kandi Uhoraho ari kumwe na we.”
Nuko Sawuli arungika intumwa kwa Isayi amutumako ati: “Ndungikira umuhungu wawe Dawidi, aragira intama.”
Nuko Isayi afata indogoba ayiremeka imikate, umukuza w’umuvinyu n’ishashi y’impene abirungikana umuhungu wiwe Dawidi kwa Sawuli.
Dawidi ashitse kwa Sawuli atangura kumukorera. Sawuli aramukunda cane, maze Dawidi aca aba umwe mu bamutwaza ibigwanisho.
Nuko Sawuli arungikira ubutumwa Isayi amubwira ati: “Unyememerere Dawidi agume ankorera, kuko arampimbara.”
Igihe cose ya mpwemu yatumwe n’Imana yaza kuri Sawuli, Dawidi yaca afata inanga yiwe akayivuza. Maze Sawuli agaca amererwa neza, kandi iyo mpwemu na yo igaca imuvako.
Hanyuma Abafilisitiya bakoranya ingabo zabo kugira ngo bagwane, bakoranira i Soko mu Buyuda, bacumbika i Efesi-Damimu, hagati y’i Soko n’i Azeka.
Sawuli n’Abisirayeli na bo barakorana bacumbika mu kiyaya ca Ela, batonda urugamba ngo bagwanye Abafilisitiya.
Nuko Abafilisitiya bahagarara ku musozi umwe, Abisirayeli na bo bahagarara ku wundi, hagati yabo hakaba ikiyaya.
Maze haza umuhizi mu ntambara yitwa Goliyati, Umufilisitiya yaturuka i Gati, asokoroka mu ngabo z’Abafilisitiya. Yari afise nk’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitandatu z’uburebure.
Ku mutwe yari yambaye inkofero icuzwe mu muringa, mu gikiriza na ho yari yambaye icuma co kumukingira gifise ibigaragamba gicuzwe mu muringa nyene gipima shekeli ibihumbi bitanu.
Ku maguru yari yambaye ivyuma vyo kuyakingira bicuzwe mu muringa, yitwaje n’icumu ricuzwe mu muringa ku bitugu.
Icumu ryiwe ryari rikwikiye mu giti kingana n’ico kujishirako impuzu, icuma caryo na co kigapima shekeli amajana atandatu. Uwamutwaza inkinzo yamugendera imbere.

Nuko Goliyati arahagarara, arasemerera abwira ingabo z’Abisirayeli ati: “Ni kuki mutonze urugamba? Jewe ndi umuhizi w’Umufilisitiya, namwe muri abagurano ba Sawuli? Nimuhitemwo umuntu umwe muri mwebwe amanuke aze duhure tugwane.
Niyashobora kungwanya akanyica, tuzoca tuba abagurano banyu; ariko ninamunesha nkamwica, muzoca muba abagurano bacu mudukorere.”
Nuko uwo Mufilisitiya arongera aravuga ati: “Uwu musi ingabo zose za Isirayeli ndazihaye ikibazo! Nimumpe umuntu aze tugwane.”
Uko bumvise amajambo y’uwo Mufilisitiya kwose, Sawuli n’Abisirayeli bose baca bacika ivutu bakagira ubwoba bwinshi.
Dawidi, yari umwe mu bahungu b’umuntu wo mu ntara ya Efurata yitwa Isayi, yaba i Betelehemu mu Buyuda. Isayi yari afise abahungu umunani, kandi mu gihe ca Sawuli we yari ashaje cane.
Abahungu ba Isayi batatu bakuru bari bajanye na Sawuli ku rugamba: imfura yitwa Eliyabu, uwa kabiri Abinadabu, n’uwa gatatu Shama.
Dawidi ni we yari umuhererezi. Abo batatu bakuru bari bajanye na Sawuli ku rugamba,
ariko Dawidi we yaja aragenda yongera agaruka, akava kwa Sawuli akaja kuragira intama za se i Betelehemu.
Nuko uwo Mufilisitiya amara imisi mirongo ine, asokoroka igitondo n’umugoroba agahagarara imbere y’ingabo z’Abisirayeli.
Umusi umwe, Isayi abwira umuhungu wiwe Dawidi ati: “Akira iyi ngero efa y’ingano zikaranze n’iyi mikate icumi ubishire bakuru bawe iyo bari ku rugamba kandi wihute.
Utware n’izo foromaji icumi uzishire umukuru w’ingabo abarongoye. Urabe uko bakuru bawe bamerewe, hanyuma unzanire inkuru y’ingene bameze.
Bakuru ba Dawidi bari kumwe na Sawuli hamwe n’abagabo b’Abisirayeli bose mu kiyaya Ela, bagwana n’Abafilisitiya.”

Mu gatondo ka kare Dawidi asigarana uwundi mwungere imikuku, atekera vya bintu aragenda, nk’uko se Isayi yamubwiye. Nuko ashika aho bacumbitse mu gihe ingabo zariko ziratonda urugamba, bavuza akamo k’intambara.
Abisirayeli n’Abafilisitiya bariko baregerana bashaka kurumana ngo bagwane.
Dawidi asigarana bimwe yajanye umurinzi w’ibikoresho, yiruka ku rugamba kuramutsa bakuru biwe no kubabaza amakuru yabo.

Akiriko araganira na bo, Goliyati, wa muhizi w’Umufilisitiya w’i Gati, yigira imbere ava aho abandi batonze urugamba bari, asubira gusemerera n’agakengerwe kenshi nk’uko yari asanzwe amenyereye kubikora. Maze Dawidi aravyumva.
Abisirayeli babonye uwo mugabo, bose baca barahunga kubera kumutinya.

Abisirayeli baguma bavugana ngo: “Murabona kirya kigabo ingene kiguma kiza? Kizanwa no gucokora Isirayeli. Umwami yaravuze ko yoha impera nini umuntu yomwica. Ngo yomuha umwe mu bakobwa biwe kandi inzu ya se ntiyosubira gutanga ikori mu miryango yose ya Isirayeli.”

Dawidi abaza abari bamwegereye ati: “Uwokwica uwo Mufilisitiya agakura agakengerwe ku Bisirayeli yokorerwa iki? Iyo ntakebwa y’Umufilisitiya yibaza ko ari iki, aho yubahuka gucokora ingabo z’Imana Nzima?”
Bamusubiriramwo vya bindi bamye bavuga bati: “Ivyo ni vyo umuntu yomwica yokorerwa.”

Maze Eliyabu, mukuru wa Dawidi, yumva ariko aravugana na ba bantu, aca arashavura cane, amubaza ati: “Ni igiki cakuzanye hano? Ni nde wasigaranye twa dutama mu bugaragwa? Ndazi ukwishira hejuru kwawe n’ububi bwo mu mutima wawe; nta kindi cakuzanye atari ukuraba intambara.”
Dawidi aramwishura ati: “None jewe ngize iki? None no kuvuga simvuge?”
Aca arimuka aja ku wundi muntu yongera kubaza ico kibazo nyene, bamwishura kwa kundi nyene.
Ivyo Dawidi yavuze bikwira hose bishikira na Sawuli, na we aca amutumako.
Dawidi abwira Sawuli ati: “Ntihagire umuntu asubira kuranduka umutima kubera uwo Mufilisitiya; jewe umusavyi wawe ngira nje kumugwanya.”
Sawuli aramwishura ati: “Ntushobora kuja kugwana n’urya Mufilisitiya; kuko uracari muto, ariko we yatanguye kugwana kuva kera akiri muto.”
Ariko Dawidi yishura Sawuli ati: “Jewe umusavyi wawe nsanzwe ndagira intama za data. Iyo intambwe canke idubu ije kwiba intama yo mu mukuku,
nca ndayikurikira, nkayigwanya, nkayiyikura mu kanwa. Yampindukirira, nkayifata mw’izosi nkayigwanya nkayica.
Jewe umusavyi wawe ko nishe intambwe n’idubu, n’uwo Mufilisitiya w’intakebwa araba nka kimwe muri ivyo, kuko yacokoye ingabo z’Imana nzima.
Uhoraho yantabaye akankura mu vyara vy’intambwe n’idubu arankura no mu kuboko kw’uwo Mufilisitiya.” Sawuli abwira Dawidi ati: “Genda, Uhoraho abane nawe.”
Nuko Sawuli yambika Dawidi umwambaro wiwe. Amwambika n’ibigwanisho vyiwe, amuha n’inkofero yiwe y’umuringa yo kwambara ku mutwe.

Maze Dawidi ahagatira inkota ya Sawuli hejuru ya wa mwambaro, agerageza gutambuka biranka kuko atari abimenyereye. Maze abwira Sawuli ati: “Sinshobora kugenda nambaye ibi bintu kuko sindabimenyereye.” Nuko arabikura.
Aca afata inkoni yiwe mu minwe, atora amabuye atanu yiburungushuye ku mugezi, ayashira mu gasaho kiwe k’abungere, ajana n’umugozi wiwe mu minwe, aca agenda atumbereye wa Mufilisitiya.
Goliyati wa Mufilisitiya na we aza guhura na Dawidi, umwe amutwaje inkinzo agendera imbere yiwe.
Aravye Dawidi akiri kure aramukengera, kuko yari akiri umuhungu muto cane, afise amagara meza kandi w’akaranga.
Abwira Dawidi ati: “Mbega mbaye imbwa, aho uza kungwanya witwaje inkoni?” Nuko wa Mufilisitiya atuka Dawidi mu mazina y’imana ziwe.
Aravuga ati: “Nuze hano, ndakubagire ibisiga n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba!”
Dawidi na we abwira wa Mufilisitiya ati: “Uje kungwanya witwaje inkota n’icumu n’ikimito, ariko jeho nje kukugwanya mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’ingabo z’Abisirayeli wacokoye.

Uwu musi Uhoraho arakugabuye mu maboko yanje, ngira ndakwice ndaguce umutwe. Uwu musi imivyimba y’Abafilisitiya ngira ndayigaburire ibisiga vyo mu kirere n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, kandi isi yose izomenya ko mu Bisirayeli hari Imana.
Kandi abakoraniye hano bose baramenya ko Uhoraho adakirisha inkota canke icumu; kuko intambara ari iy’ Uhoraho , arabagabura mu maboko yacu.”
Wa Mufilisitiya aramwegera ngo amugwanye, Dawidi na we yiruka aja iyo ari ngo bahure.
Akora muri ka gasaho atoramwo ibuye rimwe, arishira muri wa mugozi, arawuzungagiza, aritera wa Mufilisitiya mu ruhanga. Rya buye ryinjira mu gahanga kiwe, aca agwa hasi yubamye.
Nuko Dawidi anesha wa Mufilisitiya akoresheje umugozi n’ibuye rimwe; amutsinda hasi ata nkota afise, aramwica.

Dawidi ariruka amuhagarara hejuru. Afata ya nkota ya wa Mufilisitiya ayikura mu rwubati. Amaze kumwica, amuca umutwe na ya nkota yiwe. Abafilisitiya babonye ko umuhizi wabo apfuye, barahindukira barahunga.
Nuko ingabo z’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda biha akamo bakurikira Abafilisitiya gushika kw’irembo ry’i Gati n’amarembo y’i Ekuroni.
Abisirayeli bavuye gukinagiza Abafilisitiya, basahura ibintu aho bari bacumbitse.
Dawidi atwara umutwe wa wa Mufilisitiya awujana i Yerusalemu, ashira ibigwanisho vya wa Mufilisitiya mw’ihema ryiwe.

Igihe Sawuli yabona Dawidi agiye guhura na Goliyati, yabajije Abuneri, umukuru w’ingabo, ati: “Mbega Abuneri, uwo muhungu ni mwene nde?” Abuneri aramwishura ati: “Ndahiye wewe nyene, mwami, sindamuzi.”
Umwami aravuga ati: “Gerageza umenye se w’uwo muhungu.”
Dawidi avuye kwica wa Mufilisitiya, Abuneri amujana kwa Sawuli, agifise umutwe wa Goliyati mu ntoke.
Sawuli aramubaza ati: “Muhungu, uri mwene nde?” Dawidi aramwishura ati: “Ndi umuhungu w’umusavyi wawe Isayi w’i Betelehemu.”
Dawidi ahejeje kuvugana na Sawuli, Yonatani ahuza umutima wiwe n’uwa Dawidi, amukunda nk’uko yikunda.
Kuva ico gihe Sawuli aca agumya Dawidi ntiyasubira kumureka ngo asubire iwabo.
Maze Yonatani agirana isezerano na Dawidi kuko yamukunda nk’uko yikunda.
Yonatani yambura ikanzu yiwe yari yambaye ayiha Dawidi, umuha n’impuzu ziwe z’intambara, mbere n’inkota yiwe, n’umuheto n’umukanda vyose arabimuha.
Ico Sawuli yatuma Dawidi gukora cose, yaragikora kandi neza gushika aho Sawuli yamuhaye ikibanza kinini mu ngabo za Isirayeli. Ivyo bihimbara abantu bose, n’abakuru b’ingabo ba Sawuli.

Ingabo z’Abisirayeli igihe zariko zirataha Dawidi ahejeje kwica Goliyati, abagore bava mu bisagara vya Isirayeli baje guhura n’umwami Sawuli baza bavyina kandi batamba indirimbo z’umunezero bavuza utugoma n’ibindi bikoresho vyose bivuzwa mu kuririmba.
Bariko baravyina baririmba ngo: “Sawuli yishe ibihumbi, Dawidi na we ibihumbi incuro icumi.”
Urwo ruririmbo rushavuza Sawuli cane. Ariyumvira ati: “Dawidi bamuharuriye ibihumbi cumi, ariko jewe ni ibihumbi gusa. Mbega igisigaye ni iki, atari kumuha ubwami?”
Kuva ico gihe Sawuli agirira ishari Dawidi akamuraba ijisho ribi.
Bukeye impwemu mbi itumwe n’Imana iza kuri Sawuli amera nk’uwuriko avugishwa ibintu ari mu nzu iwe, Dawidi na we ariko aravuza inanga, nk’uko yahora abikora. Sawuli yari afise icumu mu minwe
aca ararimutera, yibwira ati: “Ngomba ntobekeranye Dawidi afatane n’igihome.” Ariko Dawidi ararizibukira kabiri kose.
Kuva ico gihe Sawuli aca atinya Dawidi, kuko yarabona ko Uhoraho ari kumwe na we, mugabo we akaba azi ko yamuhevye.
Maze arungika Dawidi kure yiwe amuha kuganza abasoda igihumbi. Dawidi akama ajana ingabo ku rugamba azigiye imbere.
Ivyo yakora vyose vyagenda neza, kuko Uhoraho yari kumwe na we.
Sawuli amaze kubona ko ivyo akora vyose bitera imbere, arushaho kumutinya.
Ariko Abisirayeli n’Abayuda bose bagakunda Dawidi, kuko yajana na bo ku rugamba abarongoye.

Sawuli abwira Dawidi ati: “Ng’uwu umukobwa wanje mukuru Merabi. Ndamugushingira; ariko ubanze unkorere ushizeko umwete, ugwane intambara z’ Uhoraho .” Vyatumwa n’uko Sawuli yibwira mu mutima ati: “Singomba kumukozako ukuboko ngo ndamwice, reka Abafilisitiya abe ari bo bamwica!”
Ariko Dawidi yishura Sawuli ati: “Mbega jewe ndi iki canke umuryango wa data mu Bisirayeli, aho noba umukwe w’umwami?”
Maze igihe kigeze ko Merabi umukobwa wa Sawuli ashingirwa Dawidi, ahabwa Adiriyeli w’i Mehola.
Maze Mikali umukobwa wa Sawuli akunda Dawidi, bamaze kubibwira Sawuli, aranezerwa.
Ariyumvira ati: “Nzomumuha, maze amubere umutego kugira ngo aze agwe mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.” Nuko Sawuli abwira Dawidi ati: “Uronse akandi karyo ka kabiri ko kuba umukwe w’umwami.”
Nuko Sawuli avugana n’abishikira biwe ati: “Muvugane na Dawidi mw’ibanga mumubwire muti: ‘Umwami arakunezererwa, kandi n’abishikira biwe twese turagukunda; none rero niwemere ube umukwe wiwe.’ ”
Babwira Dawidi ayo majambo. Ariko Dawidi abishura ati: “Mbega mwibaza ko ari ikintu coroshe kuronka inkwano no kuba umukwe w’umwami? Jewe ndi umukene kandi nta co maze.”
Ba bishikira ba Sawuli bamubwiye ivyo Dawidi yavuze,

Sawuli arishura ati: “Mubwire Dawidi muti: ‘Umwami ntashaka inkwano n’imwe yindi atari udukoba tw’ibitsina gabo vy’Abafilisitiya ijana, kugira ngo yihore abansi biwe.’ ” Mu mugambi wa Sawuli kwari ukugira ngo Dawidi ahitanwe n’Abafilisitiya.
Ba bakozi bamaze kubwira Dawidi ivyo vyose, aca aremera kuba umukwe w’umwami. Nuko imbere y’uko igihe yahawe gihera,

Dawidi n’abantu biwe baragenda bica Abafilisitiya amajana abiri. Aca azana igitigiri gikwiye ca twa dukoba tw’Abafilisitiya abiha umwami kugira ngo ashobore kuba umukwe w’umwami. Maze Sawuli aca amushingira umukobwa wiwe Mikali.
Sawuli abonye ko Uhoraho ari kumwe na Dawidi, kandi ko umukobwa wiwe Mikali amukunda,
Sawuli aca arushaho gutinya Dawidi, hanyuma aca amugira umwansi wiwe mu misi yose yari ashigaje kubaho.
Abakuru b’ingabo z’Abafilisitiya bashishikara gutera Isirayeli, kandi igihe cose batera, Dawidi yama abanesha akarusha abandi bakuru b’ingabo bose ba Sawuli, maze izina ryiwe riba rurangiranwa.
Sawuli abwira umuhungu wiwe Yonatani na ba bishikira biwe ngo bice Dawidi. Ariko Yonatani yarakunda cane Dawidi.
Aca aramugabisha ati: “Data Sawuli ariko ararondera akaryo ko kukwica. Nuko wirinde kandi ejo mu gitondo uze urabe aho winyegeza mu mirima ugumeyo.
Nanje nzosohokana na data duhagararane muri uwo murima aho uzoba uri. Nzovugana na we ivyawe hanyuma mpeze nkubwire uko ibintu bizoba bimeze.”
Nuko Yonatani avuga neza Dawidi imbere ya Sawuli aramubwira ati: “Umwami ntakwiye gucumura ku mukozi wiwe Dawidi, nta kibi na kimwe aragukorera; kandi ivyo yakoze vyose vyakuzaniye inyungu ihambaye.

Yahevye ubuzima bwiwe igihe yica Goliyati. Uhoraho aha Abisirayeli bose intsinzi ikomeye, kandi warabibonye kandi vyarakunezereye. None ni iki gituma ugomba kwica umuntu nka Dawidi ata kibi yakugiriye kandi udafise igituma?”
Maze Sawuli yumviriza Yonatani aca ararahira ati: “Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , Dawidi ntazokwicwa.”
Nuko Yonatani ahamagara Dawidi amubwira ivy’ico kiyago vyose. Amuzana aho Sawuli ari, Dawidi asubira kubana na Sawuli nk’ubwa mbere.
Hanyuma intambara isubira kwaduka, Dawidi aja kugwanya Abafilisitiya. Arabagwanya kugeza aho bahunga imbere yiwe.
Ariko impwemu mbi itumwe n’ Uhoraho iza kuri Sawuli aho yari yicaye mu nzu yiwe afise icumu mu minwe. Dawidi akivuza inanga,
Sawuli amutera rya cumu ariko Dawidi ararizibukira, rica ryinjira mu gihome. Kuri uwo musi Dawidi aca ahenga mw’ijoro arahunga.
Sawuli atuma abantu kwa Dawidi ngo bamuryamire maze bamwice mu gitondo bukeye. Ariko Mikali muka Dawidi aramuburira ati: “Niyo utahunga iri joro, ejo mu gitondo uzokwicwa.”
Nuko Mikali acisha Dawidi mw’idirisha, aratoroka arahunga.
Maze Mikali afata ikigirwamana c’umuryango akirambika ku buriri, agipfukisha impuzu agishirako ubwoya bw’impene ku mutwe.
Sawuli atumye ba bantu ngo bafate Dawidi, Mikali aravuga ati: “Aragwaye.”
Nuko Sawuli arongera arabatuma ngo basubire kuraba Dawidi ababwira ati: “Mumunzanire ari ku buriri aryamyeko kugira ngo ndamwice.”
Ariko ba bantu binjiye, basangamwo ca kigirwamana, ku mutwe hariko ubwoya bw’impene.
Sawuli abwira Mikali ati: “Ni kuki wampenze nk’uko ugatuma umwansi wanje ancika agahunga?” Mikali aramubwira ati: “Yambwiye ati: ‘Reka ngende. Ni iki cotuma nkwica?’ ”
Dawidi amaze guhunga aca aja kwa Samweli i Rama amubwira ivyo Sawuli yamugiriye vyose. Maze baca baja i Nayoti bagumayo.
Umuntu araza abwira Sawuli ati: “Dawidi ari i Nayoti i Rama”;
Maze arungika abantu ngo bamufate. Ariko babonye umugwi w’abavugishwa bariko baravugishwa, na Samweli ahagaze ari we abarongoye, Mpwemu w’Imana aza kuri ba bantu ba Sawuli batangura kuvugishwa.
Babibwira Sawuli, maze arungika abandi, na bo baravugishwa. Sawuli arungika abandi ubwa gatatu, na bo baravugishwa.
Mu nyuma aba ari we yigira i Rama aca aja ku kinogo kibika amazi c’i Seku. Maze arabaza ati: “Samweli na Dawidi bari he?” Baramwishura bati: “Bari i Nayoti i Rama.”
Nuko Sawuli aja i Nayoti i Rama. Ariko Mpwemu w’Imana amuzako, agenda aravugishwa kugeza ashitse i Nayoti.
Aca yiyambura impuzu ziwe, avugishirizwa mu maso ya Samweli. Aguma gutyo yambaye ubusa ijoro n’umurango. Ni co gituma abantu babibonye babaza bati: “Mbega harya na Sawuli ari mu bavugishwa n’Imana?”
Maze Dawidi arahunga ava i Nayoti i Rama, aja kwa Yonatani aramubaza ati: “Mbega nakoze iki? Icaha canje ni ikihe? Ikibi nakoreye so ni ikihe, ko agomba kunyica?”
Yonatani amwishura ati: “Ntibikabe. Ntuzopfa! Data ntiyigera akora ikintu, caba gito canke kinini, atambwiye. None ivyo yobimpisha gute? Si vyo!”

Ariko Dawidi aramurahira ati: “So arazi neza ko nagize ikiganza ciza imbere yawe, maze aca aribwira ati: ‘Yonatani ntakwiye kubimenya kuko yobabara.’ Naho biri uko ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho kandi nawe ndakurahiye, nsigaje gatoya ngapfa.”
Yonatani abwira Dawidi ati: “Ico ugomba cose ko nkora ndakigukorera.”
Nuko Dawidi aramubwira ati: “Raba ejo ni umusi mukuru w’ukwezi gushasha, nategerezwa gusangira n’umwami; ariko reka ngende nihishe mu mirima gushika ku mugoroba wa hirya y’ejo.
So niyambaza akambura, uze umubwire uti: ‘Dawidi yanyinginze ngo ndamuhe uruhusha rwo gukubitira i Betelehemu mu gisagara c’iwabo, kuko haja gutangirwa ikimazi c’umwaka c’umuryango wose.’
Niyavuga ati: ‘Ni vyiza,’ jewe umusavyi wawe nzoba ndi amahoro. Ariko niyashangashirwa, uzoce umenya ko yafashe ingingo yo kungirira nabi.

Ariko wewe, uze wereke imbabazi umusavyi wawe, kuko wanshize mw’isezerano hamwe nawe imbere y’ Uhoraho . Ninaba ntsindwa n’urubanza, ube ari wewe unyiyicira! Ni iki cotuma undekurira mu maboko ya so?”
Yonatani aravuga ati: “Ntibikabe! Mbega iyo mba namenye na gatoya ko data agomba kukugirira nabi, simba nabikubwiye?”
Dawidi arabaza ati: “Ni nde ari bumenyeshe nimba so akwishuranye ishavu?”
Yonatani aravuga ati: “Nuze, tugende mu murima.” Nuko barajana.
