Maze Yonatani abwira Dawidi ati: “Ndakurahiye Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, hirya y’ejo amasaha ageze nk’aho ageze ubu nzovugana na data! Ninasanga afise imigabo myiza kuri wewe, sinzokurungikira agakuru ngo ndakumenyeshe?
Ariko ninasanga data afise imigabo mibi yo kukugirira nabi, Uhoraho aze abimpanire, kandi birushirije, nintabikumenyesha ngo ndakubwire uhunge. Uhoraho abane nawe nk’uko yahora abana na data.
Ariko uze unyereke ukugira neza kw’ Uhoraho igihe cose nzoba nkiriho. Kandi mpfuye,
uze ugaragaze urukundo ku muryango wanje, mbere n’igihe Uhoraho azoba amaze abansi bawe bose kw’isi.”
Nuko Yonatani agirana n’inzu ya Dawidi isezerano, avuga ati: “ Uhoraho aze asubirize mu nkoko abansi ba Dawidi.”
Yonatani yongera kurahiza Dawidi ko azoguma amukunda; kandi mu vy’ukuri Yonatani yaramukunda nk’uko yikunda.
Nuko Yonatani abwira Dawidi ati: “Ejo ni umusi mukuru w’ukwezi gushasha. Uzoboneka ko atari ho uri, kuko icicaro cawe kizoba kigaragara.
Hirya y’ejo, ku muhingamo, uze uje hamwe winyegeza mbere, urindirire i ruhande y’ibuye ry’i Ezeli.
Nzorasa imyampi itatu i ruhande yaho, nk’aho noba ndiko ndarasa ikintu.

Maze nzotuma umukozi wanje mvuge nti: ‘Genda utore irya myampi.’ Ninavuga nti: ‘Ehe, imyampi iri i ruhande yawe; yinzanire,’ uzoce uza, kuko, ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , bizoba ari amahoro; nta ngorane izoba ihari.
Ariko ninabwira wa mukozi nti: ‘Imyampi yarenze inyuma yawe,’ uze uce ugenda, kuko Uhoraho azoba akwemereye kugenda.
Kandi ku vyo tuvuganye jewe nawe wibuke, Uhoraho ni we cabona cacu twempi ibihe vyose.”
Nuko Dawidi yinyegeza mu murima, maze wa musi mukuru w’ukwezi gushasha ushitse, umwami aricara ngo afungure.
Yicara mu kibanza yari asanzwe yicaramwo giherereye ku gihome, atumberanye na Yonatani, na Abuneri yicaye i ruhande ya Sawuli, ariko ikibanza ca Dawidi caragaragara.
Sawuli nta co yavuze uwo musi, kuko yiyumviriye ati: “Hoba hari icahumanije Dawidi akaba mu vy’ukuri ahumanye.”
Ariko bukeye, ku musi ugira kabiri w’ukwezi, ikibanza ca Dawidi cari kigaragara kandi. Maze Sawuli abaza umuhungu wiwe Yonatani ati: “Mbega mwene Isayi ko ataje gufungura ejo n’uwu musi?”
Yonatani aramwishura ati: “Dawidi yaranyinginze ngo ndamuhe uruhusha rwo kuja i Betelehemu.

Yavuze ati: ‘Reka ngende kuko umuryango wacu uza gutangira ikimazi mu gisagara kandi mukuru wanje yantegetse kuhaba. Ninaba ngiriwe ubuntu mu maso yawe, reka ngende kuraba bakuru banje.’ Ni co gituma atashoboye kuba ku meza hamwe n’umwami.”

Sawuli arakira Yonatani cane maze aramubwira ati: “Wa muhungu w’umugore w’ingare n’ingeso mbi! Mbega wibaza ko ntazi yuko ugomba ko mwene Isayi aba umwami mu gishingo cawe, ukaba agatetereza kuri wewe no kuri nyoko yakuvyaye?
Igihe cose urya muhungu wa Isayi azoba akiriho, yaba wewe canke ubwami bwawe ntibuzorama. Ubu rero tuma umuntu amunzanire, kuko ategerezwa gupfa!”
Yonatani abaza se ati: “Kubera iki yokwicwa? Yakoze iki?”
Nuko Sawuli abangura rya cumu ryiwe ngo arimutere. Yonatani aca amenya ko se yagabiye kwica Dawidi.
Yonatani aca arivumbura ava ku meza ashavuye cane; kuri uwo musi ugira kabiri w’ukwezi ntiyafunguye, kuko yari ababajwe n’ivyo se agirira Dawidi.
Bukeye mu gitondo Yonatani arasohoka aja mu murima ha hantu bateguye guhurira na Dawidi. Yari kumwe n’umuhungu mutoya,
maze abwira uwo muhungu ati: “Iruka untorere imyampi nza kurasa.” Wa muhungu akiriko ariruka kuyitora, arasa umwampi uramurengana.
Wa muhungu ashitse aho wa mwampi waguye, Yonatani arasemerera ati: “Mbega umwampi ntiwarenze?”
Yongera gusemerera ati: “Nyaruka ningoga! Ntuhagarare!” Wa muhungu atora wa mwampi asubira kwa shebuja.
(Uwo muhungu ntiyamenye na kimwe muri ivyo; Yonatani na Dawidi ni bo bari bazi ivyo bakora)
Yonatani aca aha vya bigwanisho wa muhungu aramubwira ati: “Genda, ubisubize mu gisagara.”
Wa muhungu amaze kugenda, Dawidi aranyeguruka ava mu bumanuko bwa rya buye yunamira Yonatani gatatu, akoza umutwe hasi. Baca baragumbirana bararira ariko Dawidi arira cane.

Yonatani aravuga ati: “Genda amahoro, kuko twasezeranye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ko tuzoba abagenzi, tukavuga tuti: ‘ Uhoraho ni we cabona hagati yawe nanje, no hagati y’uruvyaro rwawe n’urwanje ibihe vyose.’ ” Nuko Dawidi aragenda, Yonatani na we asubira mu gisagara.
Dawidi aja i Nobu, kwa Ahimeleki umuherezi. Ahimeleki amubonye agira ubwoba arajugumira, aca amubaza ati: “Ko uri wenyene? Ni kuki ata n’umwe muri kumwe?”
Dawidi yishura Ahimeleki umuherezi ati: “Umwami yantumye igikorwa aca ambwira ati: ‘Ntihagire umuntu n’umwe amenya ivyerekeye igikorwa ndagutumye.’ Abantu banje na bo nababwiye aho tuzohurira.
None ufise iki co kurya? Numpe imikate itanu canke ikindi cose woronka.”
Ahimeleki yishura Dawidi ati: “Nta mukate usanzwe mfise; ariko, hano hari imikate yejejwe nshobora kuguha, nimba abagabo muri kumwe badaherutse kuryamana n’abagore babo.”

Dawidi aramwishura ati: “Ntuhagarike umutima ku bw’ivyo. Igihe cose tuba dufise urugamba twama twirinda kuryamana n’abagore. Kandi ko bama bizigama ngo ntibiyanduze mu bihe bisanzwe, mbega ubu ntibarushiriza!”
Nuko wa muherezi amuha ya mikate ihezagiye, kuko ata yindi yariho, kiretse iyo mikate y’ishikanwa yari yakuwe imbere y’ Uhoraho uwo musi nyene isubirizwa iyindi igishushe.
Ngaho nyene, hariho umusuku wa Sawuli yari yiriwe imbere y’ Uhoraho ; yitwa Dowegi Umunyedomu, akaba umukuru w’abungere ba Sawuli.
Dawidi abaza Ahimeleki ati: “Nta cumu woba ufise ngaha canke inkota? Sinazanye inkota yanje canke ikindi kigwanisho na kimwe, kuko ico umwami yari antumye cihutirwa cane.”

Wa muherezi arishura ati: “Hari ya nkota ya Goliyati Umufilisitiya, umwe wicira mu kiyaya ca Ela; izingiriye mu mpuzu inyuma ya efodi. Niwaba uyigomba, yakire; kuko nta yindi nkota ihari atari iyo.” Dawidi aramwishura ati: “Nta yoza isumba iyo; yimpe!”
Kuri uwo musi Dawidi ahunga Sawuli, aja kwa Akishi umwami w’i Gati.

Ariko abasuku ba Akishi baramubwira bati: “Uwu si Dawidi, umwami w’igihugu ca Isirayeli? Uwu si we baririmbiye batamba, bavuga ngo: ‘Sawuli yishe ibihumbi vyiwe, Dawidi we yica ibihumbi incuro icumi’?”
Dawidi yumva ivyo bavuga vyose, aca agira ubwoba bwinshi atinya Akishi umwami w’i Gati.
Nuko aca yihindura nk’umusazi imbere yabo; akiri mu maboko yabo atangura kuvuga ibidahuye, no guharagura inzugi z’irembo no kurekereza inkonda mu bwanwa.
Akishi abwira abasuku biwe ati: “Raba uwu mugabo! Ni umusazi! Ni kuki mwamunzaniye?
Nari nkenye abasazi aho mumunzanira ngo akore ibintu nk’ivyo imbere yanje? Uwu nokwemera ko yinjira mu nzu yanje?”

headings.text: Dawidi aja i Nobu kwa Ahimeleki umuherezi

verses.text: Dawidi ava i Gati ahungira mw’isenga ry’i Adulamu. Bakuru biwe n’abo mu nzu ya se bavyumvise, baramanuka bamusangayo.
N’abandi bantu bahanzwe n’ingorane, uri abaheranye, uri abashegeshwe buzuye umwikomo, baramukurikira, araheza aba umukuru wabo. Abari kumwe na we, barashika hafi amajana ane.
Dawidi avayo aja i Misipehi i Mowabu maze abaza umwami w’i Mowabu ati: “Ndagusavye wemerere data na mama baze babe ngaha iwawe kugeza aho nzomenyera ico Imana izonkorera?”
Nuko, uhereye ico gihe abavyeyi ba Dawidi babana n’umwami w’i Mowabu kandi bagumana na we igihe cose Dawidi yamaze mu kinyegero.
Ariko, uwavugishwa n’Imana Gadi abwira Dawidi ati: “Ntugume winyegeje. Genda mu gihugu c’i Buyuda.” Nuko Dawidi aca ava ngaho aragenda yinjira mw’ishamba ry’i Hereti.
Nuko Sawuli amenya ko Dawidi n’abantu biwe hari abababonye aho bari. Sawuli yari yicaye musi y’igiti citwa tamarisi ku musozi w’i Gibeya, n’icumu ryiwe mu minwe, abishikira biwe bose bamukikije.
Sawuli arababwira ati: “Nimunyumvirize yemwe Babenyamini mwese! Mbega mwene Isayi azobaha mwese amatongo n’imizabibu? Mbega azobagira abakuru b’ingabo igihumbi abandi abagire abakuru b’ingabo ijana?

Mbega ni co gituma mwese mwagiye inama yo kungwanya? Nta n’umwe yigeze ambwira igihe umuhungu wanje yagiriraniye amasezerano na wa muhungu wa Isayi. Nta n’umwe ambabaye kuko ata n’umwe yambwiye igihe umuhungu wanje yosha uwo mukozi wanje kuntega imitego nk’uko bimeze uwu musi.”
Ariko Dowegi Umunyedomu, yari ahagararanye n’abakuru b’ingabo ba Sawuli aca aravuga ati: “Narabonye wa muhungu wa Isayi aza kwa Ahimeleki mwene Ahitubu w’i Nobu.
Ahimeleki yamusigurije Uhoraho , amuha ivyokurya, yongera amuha na ya nkota ya Goliyati Umufilisitiya.”
Nuko umwami atumako umuherezi Ahimeleki mwene Ahitubu n’umuryango wa se wose, bari abaherezi i Nobu, bose baza aho umwami yari ari.
Sawuli aravuga ati: “Umviriza rero, yewe mwene Ahitubu.” Arishura ati: “Egome nyakwubahwa.”
Sawuli aramubwira ati: “Ni kuki mwangiriye inama wewe na mwene Isayi, ukamuha ivyokurya n’inkota ukanamusiguriza Imana, kugira ngo angararize, antege n’umutego, nk’uko yabikoze uwu musi?”

Ahimeleki yishura umwami ati: “Mbega mu basavyi bawe bakwumvira ni nde yoba ari umwizigirwa wawe kunganya Dawidi, umukwe w’umwami? Si we mukuru w’ingabo zicungera ubuzima bwawe kandi yubashwe n’abo mu rugo rwawe bose?

Mbega ugira ngo uwo musi bwari bwo bwa mbere ndamusiguriza Imana? Haba na mba! Mwami, ntiwagirize umusavyi wawe canke n’umwe mu bo mu muryango wanje, kuko umusavyi wawe ata na kimwe nzi muri ivyo vyose.”
Ariko umwami aravuga ati: “Ahimeleki, ntugenda udapfuye, wewe n’umuryango wa so wose.”

Nuko umwami ategeka abamucungerera ubuzima bari i ruhande yiwe ati: “Hindukira mwice aba baherezi b’ Uhoraho , kuko na bo nyene bashigikiye Dawidi. Baramenye ko yariko arahunga, ariko ntibabimbwira.” Ariko abo bakuru ntibemera kwica abaherezi b’ Uhoraho .

Nuko umwami ategeka Dowegi ati: “Hindukira wewe wice abo baherezi.” Maze Dowegi Umunyedomu arahindukira yica ba baherezi. Kuri uwo musi yishe abagabo mirongo umunani na batanu kandi bacambaye efodi zera.
Amarisha inkota abantu b’i Nobu, igisagara c’abo baherezi, abagabo n’abagore, abana n’inzoya, inka, indogoba n’intama.
Ariko Abiyatari, mwene Ahimeleki, Ahimeleki mwene Ahitubu, arashobora kunyegera ahungira kwa Dawidi.
Maze abwira Dawidi ingene Sawuli yishe abaherezi b’ Uhoraho .
Nuko Dawidi abwira Abiyatari ati: “Kuri urya musi, igihe wa Munyedomu Dowegi yari harya, nari nzi ko ategerezwa kubibwira Sawuli. Ni jewe ntumye umuryango wa so wose upfa.
Gumana nanje; ntutinye; uwurondera kukwica ni we ariko ararondera kunyica nanje. Uri kumwe nanje uzoba amahoro.”

headings.text: Dawidi aja i Adulamu n’i Misipa

verses.text: Umusi umwe inkuru iragenda ishikira Dawidi ko Abafilisitiya bariko baratera i Keyila kandi bariko baranyaga ingano bazikura ku mbuga aho zisekurirwa.
Dawidi aca asiguza Uhoraho ati: “Ngende gutera abo Bafilisitiya?” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Egome, genda, utere Abafilisitiya utabare Keyila.”
Ariko abantu ba Dawidi baramubwira bati: “Na hano turi i Buyuda turi n’ubwoba, none twokwubahuka tukaja kugwanira Keyila, tukihanga ingabo zose z’Abafilisitiya?”
Dawidi yongera gusiguza Uhoraho , Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Manuka i Keyila, kuko nzogabura Abafilisitiya mu maboko yawe.”
Nuko Dawidi n’abantu biwe baja i Keyila, bagwanya Abafilisitiya babanyaga ibitungwa vyabo vyose. Atsinda Abafilisitiya bahaburira ibintu vyinshi cane kandi yongera akiza abantu baho.
(Abiyatari mwene Ahimeleki igihe yahungira iyo Dawidi ari i Keyila, yahunganye efodi.)
Mu nyuma, babwira Sawuli ko Dawidi yagiye i Keyila, na we aca aravuga ati: “Imana iramugabuye mu maboko yanje, kuko Dawidi yiyugaraniye mw’ibohero mu kwinjira igisagara gifise inzugi n’ibihindizo.”
Maze Sawuli atumako ingabo ziwe zose ngo baje mu ntambara, ngo bamanuke bose i Keyila bafate Dawidi n’abantu biwe.
Dawidi amenye iyo nteguro ya Sawuli, aca abwira Abiyatari umuherezi ati: “Zana ya efodi.”
Dawidi aravuga ati: “Yewe Uhoraho , Mana y’Abisirayeli, umusavyi wawe numvise ko Sawuli yateguye kuza i Keyila gusambura igisagara kubera jewe.
Mbega abantu b’i Keyila bazontanga mu maboko yiwe? Mbega Sawuli azomanuka, nk’uko navyumvise? Yewe Uhoraho , Mana y’Abisirayeli, mbwira jewe umusavyi wawe.” Maze Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Azomanuka.”
Dawidi yongera kubaza ati: “Mbega abantu b’i Keyila bazontanga mu maboko ya Sawuli?” Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Bazogutanga.”

Nuko Dawidi n’abantu bari kumwe na we, bakaba bari nk’amajana atandatu, bava i Keyila bagenda bacumbika mu bibanza bitandukanye. Sawuli amaze kubwirwa ko Dawidi yahunze akava i Keyila, ntiyaba akijayo.
Dawidi aguma yinyegeje mu bugaragwa no mu misozi yo mu bugaragwa bw’i Zifu, Sawuli akaguma amuhiga umusi ku wundi, ariko Imana ntiyagabura Dawidi mu maboko yiwe.
Igihe Dawidi yari i Horeshi mu bugaragwa bw’i Zifu, yumva ko Sawuli aje kumwica.
Maze Yonatani mwene Sawuli aja kwa Dawidi i Horeshi ajanywe no kumuremesha ngo akomere mu kwizera Imana.
Aramubwira ati: “Ntutinye. Data Sawuli ntazogukorako. Uzoba umwami w’Abisirayeli, nanje nzoba icegera cawe. Kandi na data Sawuli arabizi.”
Bompi bagira isezerano imbere y’ Uhoraho . Maze Yonatani arataha, ariko Dawidi aguma i Horeshi.
Abantu b’i Zifu baraduga kwa Sawuli i Gibeya bamubwira bati: “Mbega Dawidi ntiyinyegeje i Horeshi, ku musozi w’i Hakila, mu bumanuko bwa Yeshimoni?
None rero, mwami, manuka igihe cose uzobishakira, natwe tuzomutanga mu maboko yawe.”
Sawuli arabishura ati: “ Uhoraho abahezagire kuko mumbabaye.
Genda mutohoze neza. Mumenye aho Dawidi akunda kuja, n’umuntu yoba yaramubonyeyo. Kuko ndazi ko ari umunyabwenge.
Mumenye aho akunda kubunda hanyuma muze mumpe inkuru y’imvaho. Maze nzojana namwe; niyaba ari muri ako karere, nzomuhiga hose no mu nzu zose zo mu muryango wa Yuda.”
Nuko barasohoka bitangira imbere ya Sawuli. Dawidi n’abantu biwe bari mu bugaragwa bw’i Mayoni, muri Araba mu bumanuko bwa Yeshimoni.
Sawuli n’abantu biwe batangura kubaririkiza, maze babibwiye Dawidi, aca amanuka ku gitandara aguma mu bugaragwa bw’i Mayoni. Sawuli avyumvise, aja mu bugaragwa bw’i Mayoni ahiga Dawidi.
Sawuli yariko aca mu mbavu z’umusozi, Dawidi na we n’abantu biwe bari ku rundi ruhande, bihuta ngo basige Sawuli. Kandi Sawuli n’ingabo zari kumwe na we begereje gufata Dawidi n’abari kumwe na we,
intumwa iza kuri Sawuli imubwira iti: “Nimunyaruke ningoga! Abafilisitiya barateye igihugu.”
Maze Sawuli aca areka gukurikira Dawidi aja kugwanya Abafilisitiya. Ni co catumye aho hantu hitwa Sela Hamahilekoti risigura “igitandara co gutandukana”.
Nuko Dawidi aca araduga ava aho aja kwinyegeza i Eni-Gedi.
Sawuli avuye kugwanya Abafilisitiya, bamubwira bati: “Dawidi ari mu bugaragwa bw’i Eni-Gedi.”
Nuko atoranya abasoda b’indobanurwa ibihumbi bitatu bavuye mu Bisirayeli baja kurondera Dawidi n’abantu biwe i ruhande y’ibitandara vy’impene z’inyeshamba.
Ashitse ku mpongore z’intama zari i ruhande y’inzira; hari isenga, Sawuli aja kwihagarika muri ryo. Kandi Dawidi n’abantu biwe bari muri ryo imbere.
Ba bantu baravuga bati: “Uwu ni wa musi Uhoraho yavuga, igihe yakubwira ngo: ‘Nzogabura umwansi wawe mu maboko yawe ngo umugenze uko ushaka.’ ” Nuko Dawidi arasoboka aca ipfundo ry’ikanzu ya Sawuli.
Hanyuma Dawidi yumva umutima umurega kuko yacacuye ipfundo ry’ikanzu yiwe.
Abwira abantu biwe ati: “ Uhoraho andinde gukora ikintu nk’ico kuri databuja, uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta, canke ngo ndamuramvurireko ukuboko; kuko ari uwasizwe amavuta n’ Uhoraho .”
Avuze ivyo aca abuza abantu biwe kugirira nabi Sawuli. Maze Sawuli ava muri rya senga aragenda.
Maze Dawidi arasohoka ava muri rya senga ahamagara Sawuli ati: “Nyakwubahwa mwami wanje!” Sawuli akebutse, Dawidi arunama ashikana umutwe hasi.
Abwira Sawuli ati: “Ni kuki wumva ivyo abantu bakubwira ngo: ‘Dawidi arondera kukugirira nabi’?

Ubwawe uriboneye uwu musi ko Uhoraho yari yakugabuye mu maboko yanje muri rirya senga. Hari abampanuye kukwica, ariko nakwirekeye; navuze nti: ‘sinzobangurira ukuboko databuja, kuko yasizwe amavuta n’ Uhoraho .’

Raba, muvyeyi wanje, ehe iri pfundo ry’ikanzu yawe mu kuboko kwanje! Nacacuye ipfundo ry’impuzu yawe ariko sinakwishe. Ubu rero tahura kandi umenye ko ata kimenyetso c’uko noba narakugiriye nabi canke nkakugarariza. Nta kibi nagukoreye, ariko uriko urampiga ngo unyice.
Uhoraho naducire urubanza. Kandi Uhoraho ampore ku bibi vyose wankoreye, ariko jewe sinzogukozako ukuboko kwanje.
Nk’uko baca umugani ngo: ‘Mu munyakibi havamwo ibikorwa bibi,’ ni co gituma ntazogukozako ukuboko kwanje.
Mbega umwami w’Abisirayeli yasohotse guhiga nde? Uriko urakurikira nde? Imbwa ipfuye? Imbaragasa?
Uhoraho naducire urubanza. Arabe iconkiza akinkorere; amburanire mu kunkura mu kuboko kwawe.”
Dawidi ahejeje kuvuga ivyo Sawuli arabaza ati: “Ni wewe, ga mwana wanje Dawidi?” Araboroga cane.
Aravuga ati: “Urandushije kugororoka. Wangiriye neza, jewe nakugiriye nabi.
Uhejeje kumbwira ivyiza wankoreye; Uhoraho yari yangabuye mu maboko yawe, ariko ntiwanyishe.
Mbega umuntu afashe umwansi wiwe yomurekura atamugiriye nabi? Uhoraho aguhembere ivyo ungiriye uwu musi.
Ndazi ko utazogenda utabaye umwami kandi ko ubwami bw’Abisirayeli buzokomezwa n’amaboko yawe.
Ubu rero ndahira mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ko utazohonya uruvyaro rwanje canke ngo ufute izina ryanje mu muryango wa data.”
Nuko Dawidi arahira Sawuli. Maze Sawuli asubira iwe, ariko Dawidi n’abantu biwe baduga kwinyegeza mu misozi.
Muri ico gihe Samweli arapfa, maze Abisirayeli bose bakoranira hamwe baramuririra; bamuhamba i muhira iwe i Rama. Hanyuma Dawidi aramanuka aja mu bugaragwa bw’i Parani.
Umuntu umwe w’i Mayoni, yari afise itongo ngaho i Karumeli, yari atunze cane. Yari afise impene igihumbi n’intama ibihumbi bitatu, akaba yama azimwera ubwoya i Karumeli.

Uwo mugabo yitwa Nabali, umugore wiwe na we akitwa Abigayili. Uwo mugore yari umunyabwenge kandi akaba mwiza cane, ariko umugabo wiwe, yakomoka mu muryango wa Kalebu, yari umuntu agoye kandi w’ingeso mbi.
Dawidi akiri mu bugaragwa, yumva ko Nabali ariko aramwa intama ubwoya.
Nuko arungika abasore cumi arababwira ati: “Nimugende kwa Nabali i Karumeli mumundamukirize.
Mumubwire muti: ‘Urakaramba! Ugire amagara meza n’ivyo utunze vyose n’abawe bose! Amagara meza abe ku kintu cose citwa icawe!
Numvise ko ari igihe co kumwa intama zawe. None rero, abungere bawe bari kumwe natwe, ntitwigeze tubagirira nabi, kandi igihe cose bamaze i Karumeli nta kintu na kimwe mu vyabo cazimiye.
Baza n’abakozi bawe barabikubwira. Nuko rero ugirire neza aba bantu banje, kuko tuje ari ku musi mukuru. Ndakwinginze nuhe abasavyi bawe n’umuhungu wawe Dawidi ico ushobora kubaronkera cose.’ ”
Ba bantu ba Dawidi bashitse, bashikiriza Nabali bwa butumwa bwa Dawidi, baca bararindira.
Nabali yishura ba basore ba Dawidi ati: “Uwo Dawidi ni nde? Mwene Isayi ni nde? Muri iyi misi hari abakozi benshi bahunga ba shebuja.
Ni kuki nofata indya zanje n’amazi yanje, n’inyama nabagiye abariko baramwa intama, ngo ndabihe abantu ntazi iyo bavuye?”
Ba bantu ba Dawidi barahindukira basubira inyuma. Bashitse, bamushikiriza ivyo babwiwe vyose.

Dawidi abwira abantu biwe ati: “Nimwambare inkota zanyu!” Nuko bambara inkota zabo, na Dawidi na we nyene yambara iyiwe. Abagabo bashika nk’amajana ane badugana na Dawidi, amajana abiri na bo basigara barinze ibintu.
Umwe mu bakozi abwira Abigayili muka Nabali ati: “Dawidi yarungitse intumwa ziva mu bugaragwa zizaniye indamukanyo databuja, ariko yabakiriye nabi arabatuka.
Kandi abo bantu batugiriye neza cane, nta kibi na kimwe bigeze batugirira, kandi igihe cose twari mu misozi hafi y’aho bari nta na kimwe cabuze.
Mw’ijoro no ku murango bari nk’uruzitiro rudukikije igihe cose twari turagiye intama hafi yabo.
None rero nuvyiyumvire ugire ico ukoze, kuko ivyago bihanamiye databuja n’abo mu rugo rwiwe rwose. Ni umuntu mubi ku buryo ata muntu yomuvugisha.”

Abigayili ntiyatevye. Afata imikate amajana abiri, imikuza ibiri y’umuvinyu, intama zitanu zateguwe neza, ingero seya zitanu z’ingano zikaranze, n’amahando y’inzabibu zumye ijana n’udukate dukozwe mu nsukoni ziseye, abikorera indogoba.
Maze abwira abakozi biwe ati: “Nimunyitangire imbere; nanje ndaza inyuma yanyu.” Ariko ntiyabwira umugabo wiwe Nabali.
Maze aragenda ari ku ndogoba yiwe ku mpinga y’umusozi, Dawidi n’abantu biwe bariko baramanuka batumbereye iyo ari, hanyuma barahura.
Dawidi yari yavuze ati: “Nta co vyamaze kuba narinze neza ibintu vy’uwu mugabo mu bugaragwa kugira ngo ntihagire ikibura. Anyishuye ibibi ku vyiza namukoreye.
Imana ize ibimpanire, mbere birushirije, nihashika mu gitondo hagisigaye izina muhungu mu bantu biwe!”
Abigayili abonye Dawidi, yururuka ningoga ava ku ndogoba yiwe yunama imbere ya Dawidi, yubamye hasi.
Yubama imbere y’ibirenge vyiwe avuga ati: “Nyakwubahwa, amakosa yose naje kuri jewe. Ndakwinginze, unyemerere umusavyikazi wawe mvugane nawe; Niwumvirize ivyo umusavyikazi wawe ngira mvuge.

Icompa umwami wanje ntashire umutima ku vyo urya muntu mubi Nabali yavuze. Izina ni ryo muntu, izina ryiwe ni igipfu, kandi ubupfu bujana na we. Ariko jeho, umusavyikazi wawe, sinabonye abantu databuja yari yarungitse.”

“None rero nyakwubahwa, ko Uhoraho yakurinze ngo ntuvishe amaraso kandi ntiwihore n’amaboko yawe, ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho n’ukubaho kwawe nyene, icompa abansi bawe n’abagomba kukugirira nabi bakaba nka Nabali.
Kandi iri shikanwa, umusavyikazi wawe nzaniye databuja, rihabwe aba bantu bari inyuma yawe.
Harira icaha c’umusavyikazi wawe, kuko Uhoraho azoshimangira ubwami bwa databuja, kuko ugwana intambara z’ Uhoraho . Ntihabe igikorwa kibi kiboneka kuri wewe igihe cose ukiriho.
Naho hari umuntu aguhiga ngo akwice, ubuzima bwa databuja buzozigamirwa mw’isi y’abazima n’ Uhoraho Imana yawe. Ariko ubuzima bw’abansi bawe buzoshiburirwa kure nk’ibuye ritewe n’umugozi.
Igihe Uhoraho azoba yakugiriye vya vyiza vyose yagusezeranira kandi niyaba yakugize umurongozi w’Abisirayeli,
ntuze ugire ikikwagiriza mu mutima ko wishe umuntu bidakenewe canke ko wihoye. Kandi Uhoraho niyakugirira neza, nyakwubahwa, uze wibuke umusavyikazi wawe.”
Dawidi abwira Abigayili ati: “ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli ahimbazwe, yakurungitse uwu musi guhura nanje.
Uragahezagirwa kuko wiyumviriye neza ukaza kuntangira ngo simvishe amaraso uwu musi kandi ngo sinihore n’amaboko yanje ubwanje.

Iyo bitaba uko, ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, yandinze ngo sindabagirire nabi, iyo utaba waje wihuta aho ndi, nta zina muhungu mu ba Nabali yari gusigara akiriho ejo mu mutwenzi.”
Maze Dawidi yakira ivyo wa mugore yari azanye vyose aca amubwira ati: “Genda amahoro. Numvise amajambo yawe kandi nkoze ivyo wasavye.”
Abigayili agiye kwa Nabali, asanga ari mu nzu yateguye amazimano nk’ay’umwami. Yari yaborewe cane atakimenya ico avuga. Nuko ntiyagira ico amubarira gushika bukeye.
Maze mu gitondo, Nabali inzoga zamuvuyeko, umugore wiwe amubwira ivyaraye bibaye, aca agwa igihumura umutima wiwe umera nk’ibuye.
Haciye nk’imisi cumi, Uhoraho akubita Nabali arapfa.

Dawidi yumvise ko Nabali yapfuye, aravuga ati: “ Uhoraho ahimbazwe, yangwaniye kwa Nabali kuko yari yankengereye. Yarinze umusavyi wayo gukora ikibi maze isubiza ibibi Nabali yakoze ku mutwe wiwe ubwiwe.” Maze Dawidi atuma intumwa kuri Abigayili, amusaba ko yomubera umugore.
Abakozi biwe bagenda i Karumeli babwira Abigayili bati: “Dawidi yadutumye ngo tukujane umubere umugore.”
Maze arunama ashikana umutwe hasi, avuga ati: “Umusavyikazi wawe ndi hano, niteguriye kugukorera no kwoza ibirenge vy’abakozi ba databuja.”
Abigayili ava hasi ningoga yurira indogoba, aherekejwe n’abaguranokazi biwe batanu, bajana na za ntumwa za Dawidi aca aba umugore wiwe.
Dawidi yari yararongoye na Ahinowamu w’i Yezireyeli, bompi bari abagore biwe.
Ariko Sawuli yari yaramaze guha umukobwa wiwe Mikali muka Dawidi, umugabo yitwa Palutiyeli mwene Layishi yava i Galimu.
Abantu b’i Zifu bagenda kwa Sawuli i Gibeya bamubwira bati: “Mbega Dawidi ntiyinyegeje ku musozi w’i Hakila, uhereranye n’i Yeshimoni?”
Nuko Sawuli aramanuka aja mu bugaragwa bw’i Zifu, ari kumwe n’ingabo ibihumbi bitatu vy’abahizi b’indobanurwa mu Bisirayeli, agiye guhiga Dawidi.
Sawuli ashinga amahema y’ikambi yiwe i ruhande y’inzira iri ku musozi w’i Hakila hahereranye n’i Yeshimoni, ariko Dawidi aguma mu bugaragwa. Yumvise ko Sawuli yamukurikiyeyo,
aca arungika abantu kugendereza, kugira ngo amenye ko Sawuli yashitse vy’ukuri.
Nuko Dawidi arasoboka aja hamwe Sawuli yari acumbitse. Abona aho Sawuli na Abuneri mwene Neri, umukuru w’ingabo bari, baryamye. Sawuli yari aryamye hagati muri iyo kambi, ingabo zose zimukikije.
Nuko Dawidi abaza Ahimeleki Umuheti na Abishayi mwene Zeruwiya, murumuna wa Yowabu ati: “Ni nde yemera kumanukana nanje aho Sawuli ari mw’ikambi?” Abishayi aramwishura ati: “Jewe turajana.”
Nuko Dawidi na Abishayi bagenda aho za ngabo ziri mw’ijoro, babona Sawuli, aryamye asinziriye hagati y’ingabo n’icumu ryiwe rishinze hasi hafi y’umutwe wiwe. Abuneri n’izindi ngabo bari bamukikije.
Abishayi abwira Dawidi ati: “Uyu musi Imana igabuye umwansi wawe mu maboko yawe. Nyemerera rero ndamucumite rimwe gusa icumu ryanje rice rimufatanya n’isi; sincumita kabiri.”
Ariko Dawidi abwira Abishayi ati: “Oya, ntumwice! Ni nde yoramvurira ukuboko ku wo Uhoraho yarobanuje amavuta, ntabeko icaha?
Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , Uhoraho ubwiwe ni we azomwiyicira; canke na ho umusi wiwe uzoshika apfe, canke azoja mu ntambara agweyo.
Ariko Uhoraho andinde gukoza ukuboko ku muntu yarobanuje amavuta. Ubu genda utore rirya cumu n’umukuza w’amazi biri ku mutwe wiwe, tugende.”
Nuko Dawidi atwara rya cumu na wa mukuza w’amazi vyari ku mutwe wa Sawuli, baca barigira. Bose bari basinziriye, kuko Uhoraho yari yabasinzirije ubutikoma.
Maze Dawidi arajabuka aja hakurya ahagarara ku gatwe k’umusozi uri hirya y’aho bacumbitse; mugabo atari hafi.
Ahamagara ingabo na Abuneri mwene Neri ati: “Mbega Abuneri, ko utanyishura?” Abuneri arishura ati: “Uri nde uvyura umwami?”
Dawidi aramwishura ati: “Wewe nzi ko uri umugabo, si ko none? Kandi ni nde muri Isirayeli ahambaye nkawe? None ni iki catumye udateramira shobuja umwami igihe umuntu yaza kumwica.

Ivyo wakoze si vyiza. Ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho wewe n’ingabo muri kumwe mukwiye gupfa, kuko mutateramiye shobuja, uwo Uhoraho yimikishije amavuta. Raba hose! Icumu n’umukuza w’amazi vy’umwami vyari i ruhande y’umutwe wiwe biri hehe?”
Sawuli amenya ijwi rya Dawidi aravuga ati: “Ni wewe ga mwana wanje Dawidi?” Dawidi aramwishura ati: “Egome ni jewe databuja, mwami.”
Arongerako ati: “Ni kuki databuja umwami ahiga jewe umusavyi wiwe? Ni igiki nakoze kibi, nagirizwa iki?

None rero niwumvirize amajambo y’umusavyi wawe. Nimba Uhoraho ari we yakundekuriyeko, niyemere ndamuhe ikimazi. Ariko nibaba ari abantu, nibavumwe imbere y’ Uhoraho ! Kuko bankuye mu mugabane wanje mu vyo Uhoraho yaturaze bakavuga ngo: ‘Genda ukorere izindi mana.’
Nuko ntureke ngo amaraso yanje asesekere kure y’inyonga z’ Uhoraho . Umwami w’Abisirayeli yasohokanywe no guhiga jewe imbaragasa nk’uko umuntu ahiga inkware mu misozi?”

Maze Sawuli aravuga ati: “Nacumuye. Garuka, Dawidi mwana wanje. Kuko wahaye agaciro ubuzima bwanje uwu musi, sinzosubira kurondera kukugirira nabi. Ni ivy’ukuri, nakoze nk’igipfu, kandi nihenze cane.”
Dawidi aramwishura ati: “Ng’iri icumu ry’umwami. Tuma umwe mu basore bawe aze kuritora.
Uhoraho agerera umuntu wese ibihwanye n’ubugororotsi bwiwe n’ubwizigirwa bwiwe. Uhoraho yakugabuye mu maboko yanje uwu musi, ariko sinokoza ukuboko ku wo Uhoraho yarobanuje amavuta.
Nk’uko nahaye ubuzima bwawe agaciro, abe ari ko Uhoraho aha agaciro ubuzima bwanje ankize amagorwa yose.”
Nuko Sawuli abwira Dawidi ati: “Uragahezagirwa, mwana wanje Dawidi; uzokora ibihambaye kandi ni ukuri uzonesha.” Nuko Dawidi arigira, Sawuli na we asubira iwe.
Maze Dawidi ariyumvira ati: “Umusi umwe Sawuli azomfata. Icoba ciza ni uko nohungira mu Bafilisitiya. Maze Sawuli azoca aheba kundonderera ahantu na hamwe muri Isirayeli, nanje nzoca ndamukira.”
Nuko Dawidi na ba bantu amajana atandatu bari kumwe na we baja kwa Akishi mwene Mayoshi, umwami w’i Gati.

Dawidi n’abantu biwe baba i Gati hamwe na Akishi. Umugabo wese yari kumwe n’umuryango wiwe, na Dawidi yari kumwe n’abagore biwe babiri: Ahinowamu w’i Yezireyeli na Abigayili w’i Karumeli yahora ari umugore wa Nabali.
Sawuli amaze kumenya ko Dawidi yahungiye i Gati, ntiyongera kumuhiga.

Nuko Dawidi abwira Akishi ati: “Ninaba ngiriwe ubuntu mu maso yawe, ndasavye ugire aho umpaye mu bisagara vyo mu gihugu cawe, kugira ngo mbeyo. Mbega ni kuki umusavyi wawe nobana nawe mu gisagara c’ubwami?”
Nuko kuri uwo musi Akishi amuha Zikulagi, kandi aho haciye hegukira abami b’i Buyuda kuva ico gihe kugeza n’ubu.
Dawidi amara umwaka n’amezi ane mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya.
Nuko Dawidi n’abantu biwe bava ngaho baja kugwanya Abageshuri, Abagiruzi n’Abamaleki. (Kuva kera abo bantu baba hafi y’i Shuri, hegereye ku rubibe rwa Egiputa.)
Igihe cose Dawidi yatera ahantu, nta muntu n’umwe yasiga ari muzima, yaba umugabo canke umugore, ariko yaca atwara intama n’inka, indogoba n’ingamiya, n’impuzu. Maze agaca asubira kwa Akishi.
Maze Akishi abajije ati: “Mwagiye gutera hehe uwu musi?” Dawidi yaca avuga ati: “Twateye i Negebu h’i Buyuda” canke ati: “Twateye i Negebu h’i Yerahimeyeli” canke ati: “Twateye i Negebu h’Abakayini.”

Ntiyasigaza umugore canke umugabo yozana ari muzima i Gati, kuko yibaza ati: “Bohava batanga inkuru kuri twebwe bakavuga bati: ‘Ibi ni vyo Dawidi yakoze.’ ” Uko ni ko yakora igihe cose yabaye mu gihugu c’i Bufilisitiya.
Nuko Akishi yizigira Dawidi, yibwira ati: “Yarigize uwo kwankwa urunuka n’abo mu gihugu ciwe b’Abisirayeli, rero azoba umushumba wanje ibihe vyose.”
Muri iyo misi Abafilisitiya bakoranya ingabo zabo kugira ngo baje kugwanya Abisirayeli. Akishi abwira Dawidi ati: “Wewe n’iyo misore yawe muzojana nanje ku rugamba.”
Dawidi aramwishura ati: “Ni ho uzokwibonera ubwawe ivyo umusavyi wawe nshobora gukora.” Akishi aramwishura ati: “Ni vyiza, kandi nanje nzokugira uwuncungerera ubuzima.”
Ico gihe Samweli yari yarapfuye, Abisirayeli bose bari baramugandariye, bamuhamba mu gisagara c’iwabo i Rama. Kandi Sawuli yari yarirukanye mu gihugu abapfumu n’abahamagara imizimu bose.
Abafilisitiya barakorana baragenda bashinga ikambi yabo i Shunemu, ico gihe Sawuli na we akoranya Abisirayeli bose bashinga ikambi yabo i Gilibowa.
Sawuli abonye ingabo z’Abafilisitiya, aratinya; ubwoba bwuzura umutima wiwe.
Asiguza Uhoraho , ariko Uhoraho ntiyamwishura haba mu nzozi, haba mu buryo bwa Urimu canke aciye mu bavugishwa.
Sawuli abwira abakozi biwe ati: “Nimundonderere umugore ahamagara imizimu, kugira ngo ngende kumusiguza.” Baramubarira bati: “Hariho umwe ari i Eni-Dori.”
Maze Sawuli ariyoberanya, yambara izindi mpuzu, mw’ijoro ajana n’abantu babiri kwa wa mugore. Aramubwira ati: “Nsiguriza imizimu, umpamagarire uw’uwo nja kukubwira.”
Ariko wa mugore amubwira ati: “Ni ukuri urazi neza ivyo Sawuli yakoze n’ingene yakuyeho abahamagara imizimu n’abapfumu mu gihugu. Ni kuki ugomba kuntega umutego ngo uncishe agatwe?”
Sawuli aramurahira mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ati: “Ndakurahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , ko ivyo utazobihanirwa.”
Maze wa mugore aramubaza ati: “Ndaguhamagarire nde?” Aramubwira ati: “Mpamagarira Samweli.”
Wa mugore abonye Samweli, araboroga cane, abwira Sawuli ati: “Ni kuki wampenze? Uri Sawuli!”
Umwami aramubwira ati: “Ntutinye. Ubonye iki?” Wa mugore aravuga ati: “Mbonye igisa n’umuzimu kiduga kiva mu kuzimu.”
Aramubaza ati: “Gisa gute?” Aramwishura ati: “Umutama yambaye ikanzu ni we aduze.” Nuko Sawuli amenya ko ari Samweli, aca aramwunamira, akubita ibipfukamiro akoza umutwe hasi.

Samweli abwira Sawuli ati: “Ni kuki uriko urangora umpamagara ngo ngaruke?” Aravuga ati: “Ni uko ndi mu mubabaro mwinshi. Abafilisitiya baranteye, kandi Imana yarampevye. Ntikinyishura, haba biciye mu bavugishwa canke mu nzozi. Ni co gituma naguhamagaye ngo umbwire ico nkwiye gukora.”
Samweli aramubwira ati: “Ni iki gitumye unsiguza, kandi Uhoraho yaraguhevye akaba umwansi wawe?
Uhoraho akoze ivyo yari yaravuze aciye kuri jewe. Uhoraho agushikuye ubwami mu maboko yawe kandi buhawe uwo muhanganye ari we Dawidi.
Uhoraho agukoreye ivyo uwu musi, kuko utumviye Uhoraho canke ngo ushitse uburake bwiwe bwose ku Bamaleki.
Uhoraho arakugabuye wewe n’Abisirayeli bose mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya, kandi ejo wewe n’abahungu bawe muzoba muri kumwe nanje. Kandi Uhoraho azogabura ingabo z’Abisirayeli mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.”
Ubwo nyene Sawuli aca agwa hasi yubamye, yuzuye ubwoba kubera amajambo ya Samweli. Inkomezi zirahera, kuko ata co yari yariye uwo musi wose n’ijoro ryose.
Wa mugore aje aho Sawuli ari, akabona ko yagize ubwoba bwinshi, aramubwira ati: “Raba, umusavyikazi wawe nakwumviye. Nahevye amagara yanje nkora ivyo wantegetse.
None rero umviriza ivyo umusavyikazi wawe mvuga kandi unyemerere ndakuzanire imfungurwa kugira ngo urye, usubizwemwo intege ushobore gutaha.”
Aranka aravuga ati: “Sindya.” Ariko abantu bari kumwe na we bafatanya n’uwo mugore baramwinginga, maze arabumvira. Ava hasi yicara ku buriri.
Wa mugore arihuta afata ishuri ivyibushe, arayibaga ubwo nyene. Afata ifu, arayicumba akoramwo udukate twokeje twacumbanywe amavuta, tutarimwo umwambiro.
Nuko abishira imbere ya Sawuli n’abantu biwe, bararya. Muri iryo joro nyene bava hasi baragenda.
Abafilisitiya bakoranya ingabo zabo zose i Afeki, Abisirayeli na bo bacumbika ku mugezi w’i Yezireyeli.
Maze abakuru b’ingabo z’Abafilisitiya barongoye imice y’amajana n’ibihumbi, hamwe na Dawidi n’abantu biwe bagendera inyuma bari kumwe na Akishi.

Abakuru b’ingabo barabaza bati: “Ivy’aba Baheburayo bimeze gute?” Akishi arabishura ati: “Uwu si Dawidi yahora ari umwe mu bakuru b’ingabo kwa Sawuli umwami w’Abisirayeli? Amaze umwaka urenga ari kumwe nanje, kandi kuva ava kwa Sawuli gushika uwu musi nta co ndamugaya.”

Ariko ba bakuru b’Abafilisitiya baramushavurira baramubwira bati: “Subiza uwo mugabo inyuma, asubire mu kibanza yagenewe. Ntashobora kujana natwe mu ntambara, yohava aduhindukirira, akatugwanya. Hari ubundi buryo yokwiyuzuza na shebuja atari uguca imitwe izi ngabo zacu?
Uwo si Dawidi umwe bavyinira batamba ngo: ‘Sawuli yishe ibihumbi vyiwe, ariko Dawidi we yishe ibihumbi vyiwe incuro cumi’?”

Maze Akishi ahamagara Dawidi aramubwira ati: “Ndakurahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho , wabaye umwizigirwa, kandi vyari bimpimbaye ko ujana nanje mu rugamba. Kuva ku musi waziye iwanje gushika uwu musi, nta kibi nakubonyeko, ariko abatware ntibakwemera.
Isubirire inyuma mu mahoro; ntihagire ico ukora coshavuza abakuru b’Abafilisitiya.”
Dawidi aramubaza ati: “Nakoze iki? Ni igiki wabonye wokwagiriza umusavyi wawe kuva ku musi naziyeko iwawe gushika ubu? Ni iki combuza kuja kugwanya abansi ba databuja umwami?”
Akishi aramwishura ati: “Ndazi ko wamye unezera nka marayika w’Imana; ariko abakuru b’ingabo bavuze bati: ‘Ntajane natwe ku rugamba.’
Nuko uze uvyuke kare, hamwe n’ingabo zawe mwazananye, mugende hakiri kare.”
Nuko Dawidi n’abantu biwe bavyuka kare mu gitondo basubira mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya, Abafilisitiya na bo baraduga baja i Yezireyeli.
Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe bashika i Zikulagi ku musi ugira gatatu. Kandi Abamaleki bari bateye i Negebu n’i Zikulagi; i Zikulagi barahaturira,
batwara nk’inyagano abagore n’abandi bantu bose bari kumwe na bo, abato n’abakuze. Ntibishe n’umwe, ariko babajanye bose iyo bariko baraja.
Dawidi n’abo bari kumwe bashika i Zikulagi, basanga hatongowe n’umuriro, abagore, abana babo b’abahungu n’abakobwa bajanywe nk’inyagano.
Nuko Dawidi n’abo bari kumwe bararira cane gushika aho batakironka n’inkomezi zo kurira.
Abagore ba Dawidi babiri, Ahinowamu w’i Yezireyeli na Abigayili umupfakazi wa Nabali w’i Karumeli, na bo nyene bari mu batwawe.

Dawidi aja mu kaga gakomeye, kuko abantu bari bababajwe cane no kubura abahungu babo n’abakobwa babo, hanyuma batangura kuvugana ko bomwicisha amabuye. Ariko Dawidi aremeshwa n’inkomezi ziva k’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe.
Maze Dawidi abwira Abiyatari umuherezi, mwene Ahimeleki ati: “Nzanira efodi.” Abiyatari arayimuzanira,
maze Dawidi asiguza Uhoraho ati: “Nkurikire aba baduteye? Mbega noba nkibahamvya?” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Bakurikire. Kandi uraza kubahamvya ugarure n’ivyo banyaze vyose.”
Dawidi na ba bantu amajana atandatu bari kumwe na we baragenda bashika ku ruzi rw’i Besori, bamwe basigaraho,
kuko abashika amajana abiri bari barushe cane bibananira kujabuka urwo ruzi. Ariko Dawidi n’abandi amajana ane babandanya babakurikira.
Babonye Umunyegiputa mu mirima bamuzanira Dawidi. Bamuha amazi yo kunywa n’ivyokurya
igice c’umukate ukozwe mu nsukoni n’udukate tubiri ducumvye mu nzabibu. Ararya asubiramwo intege, kuko yari amaze imisi itatu n’amajoro atatu ata co arya canke anywa.
Dawidi aramubaza ati: “Uri uwo kwa nde, kandi uva hehe?” Aramwishura ati: “Ndi Umunyegiputa, umugurano w’Abamaleki. Databuja yantaye ngaha kubera ngwaye haciye imisi itatu.
Twateye i Negebu h’Abakereti no mu ntara ya Yuda n’i Negebu kwa Kalebu, duturira n’i Zikulagi.”
Dawidi aramubaza ati: “Woshobora kunjana aho abo bateye bari?” Aramwishura ati: “Ndahira imbere y’Imana ko utanyica canke ngo untange mu maboko ya databuja, nca ndakumanukana iyo bari.”
Nuko amanukana Dawidi, asanga basanzaye ku misozi y’ico gihugu, bariko bararya banywa, bagira umusi mukuru kubera ibintu vyinshi banyaze mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya n’i Buyuda.

Dawidi n’abantu biwe barabahwikira, babinjiramwo barabagwanya kuva iryo joro ryose kugeza ku mugoroba w’umusi ukurikira, arabanesha kandi nta n’umwe yashoboye gucika ngo ahunge, atari abasore amajana ane basimbiye ku ngamiya bariruka barahunga.
Dawidi agarura ivyo Abamaleki bari banyaze vyose, harimwo na ba bagore biwe babiri.
Nta na kimwe cari kibuzemwo: abakiri bato n’abakuze, abahungu n’abakobwa, n’ivyanyazwe vyose vyari bikwiye. Dawidi arabigarukana vyose.
Ajana amasho n’imikuku, maze abantu biwe babishira imbere y’ibindi bitungwa bagenda bavuga bati: “Ibi ni ivyo Dawidi yanyaze.”

Nuko Dawidi ashikira ba bandi amajana abiri bari barushe basigaye inyuma mu Kiyaya ca Besori. Baza gusanganira Dawidi n’abari kumwe na we bose, Dawidi na we arabaramutsa anezerewe, ababaza ingene bamerewe.

Ariko abantu babi n’abansi b’amahoro bari mu bajanye na Dawidi baravuga bati: “Ko batajanye natwe ku rugamba, ntitwemera kugabura na bo ivyo twanyaze. Ariko umuntu wese ahitane umugore wiwe n’abana biwe ace agenda.”
Dawidi arabishura ati: “Oyaye, bavukanyi, ntimukore uko ku vyo Uhoraho yaduhaye. Yaturinze yongera agabura mu maboko abari baje kudutera.
Ni nde yobashigikira muvuze ibintu nk’ivyo? Umugabane w’uwasigaranye ibintu ni umwe n’uw’uwagiye ku rugamba. Imigabane yabo irangana.”
Maze Dawidi abigira itegeko mu Bisirayeli kuva uwo musi gushika n’ubu.
Dawidi ashitse i Zikulagi, arungikira abakuru b’i Buyuda, bari basanzwe ari abagenzi biwe, ababwira ati: “Iyi ni ingabire ivuye mu vyo twanyaze abansi b’ Uhoraho .”
Arungikira n’ab’i Beteli, Rama Negebu n’i Yatiri;
abo muri Aroweri, Sifumoti, Eshitemowa
n’i Rakali; abo mu bisagara vy’Abayerahimeyeli n’Abakayini;
ab’i Horuma, n’i Bori Ashani, Ataki
n’i Heburoni; no mu tundi turere twose Dawidi n’abari kumwe na we bari baraciyemwo.
Maze Abafilisitiya bagwanya Abisirayeli; Abisirayeli barata barahunga, kandi benshi muri bo bicirwa ku musozi Gilibowa.
Abafilisitiya babirukako basugereza Sawuli n’abahungu biwe, bica abahungu biwe Yonatani, Abinadabu na Maluki-Shuwa.
Maze Sawuli urugamba rumumerera nabi cane, abanyamiheto baramurasa, arakomereka bikomeye.

Sawuli abwira uwari amutwaje ibigwanisho ati: “Sokora inkota yawe unsogote, kugira ngo izo ntakebwa ntizimfate ngo zinsogote, zinyice nabi.” Ariko uwamutwaza ibigwanisho aranka kuko yari afise ubwoba bwinshi. Nuko Sawuli afata inkota yiwe ayisukako.
Umwe yamutwaza ibigwanisho abonye ko Sawuli apfuye, na we nyene yisuka ku nkota yiwe bagwa hamwe.
Nuko Sawuli n’abahungu biwe batatu n’uwamutwaza ibigwanisho hamwe n’abantu biwe bapfira hamwe bose kuri uwo musi nyene.

Abisirayeli bari mu kiyaya n’abari hakurya ya Yorodani babonye ko ingabo z’Abisirayeli zihunze kandi ko Sawuli n’abahungu biwe bapfuye, baca bata ibisagara vyabo barahunga. Maze Abafilisitiya baraza babibamwo.
Bukeye, Abafilisitiya baja aho urugamba rwabereye kwambura abapfuye ibigwanisho n’ibintu vyabo vy’agaciro, basanga Sawuli n’abahungu biwe batatu baguye ku musozi Gilibowa.
Bamuca umutwe, bamwambura n’ibigwanisho vyiwe, baca barungika intumwa mu gihugu cose c’Abafilisitiya ngo bakwize iyo nkuru mu ngoro z’ibigirwamana vyabo no mu bantu.
Baca bashira ibigwanisho vyiwe mu ngoro y’imanakazi Ashitaroti, babohera umuvyimba wiwe ku ruhome rw’i Beti-Shani.
Maze abantu b’i Yabeshi Gileyadi bumvise ivyo Abafilisitiya bakoreye Sawuli,
abagabo bose b’abahizi bagenda ijoro ryose baja i Beti-Shani. Bafata imivyimba ya Sawuli n’abahungu biwe bayikura ku ruhome rw’i Beti-Shani, bayijana i Yabeshi barayiturira.
Maze bafata amagufa yabo bayahamba musi y’igiti c’umutamarisi c’i Yabeshi, baca barisonzesha kumara imisi indwi.
